🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #24 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 China says ready to work with India to facilitate visa issuance for business people

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 04:25:24 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The spokesperson’s remarks came amid reports that Chinese diplomatic missions have reduced visa issuance to Indian nationals, including business visas

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: China has said it is ready to work with India to facilitate visa arrangements for business personnel from both sides, amid reports that its diplomatic missions have reduced visa issuance, including business visas, to Indian nationals. "China issues visas for eligible foreign nationals coming to China in accordance with laws and regulations," a Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesperson said in a written reply to questions by PTI about the reported reductions in visa issuance for Indians. “We stand ready to work with India to facilitate visa arrangements for business personnel of both sides," the spokesperson said. The spokesperson's remarks came amid reports that Chinese diplomatic missions have reduced visa issuance to Indian nationals, including business visas. Also, fewer Indian businessmen were reportedly given visas to attend this month’s China Import Expo in Shanghai. The annual trade fair attracts businessmen from around the world to showcase their businesses to Chinese consumers. Beijing has also stopped the service provider China Visa Application Centre from accepting visa applications, and its missions have begun handling them directly amid rising demand for Chinese visas, especially business visas. The visa process between the two countries improved after India began issuing tourist visas to Chinese nationals in July last year after a gap of five years, amid efforts to repair bilateral ties that came under severe strain following the deadly Galwan Valley clashes in 2020. The resumption of the visas was regarded as a significant move as the two countries started the normalisation process after a freeze in bilateral ties. With liberalised visa processes, the two countries launched direct air services connecting several cities, including Beijing-New Delhi.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: According to Indian officials, the visa rejection rate for Chinese nationals has been reduced to around 7% in recent months to encourage more business and tourism-related travel to India.

articles.title: Study finds PTSD-specific brain changes, paving way for personalised treatment
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The study uncovered specific changes in the brain linked to PTSD

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A new study has found that DNA methylation, a natural process that acts like a "dimmer switch" to turn genes down or completely off, varies more than expected across different brain regions in genes linked to PTSD. Stress and trauma can leave molecular marks in the brain that may help explain the development of post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), a mental health disorder in which one experiences flashbacks or nightmares of a terrifying or life-threatening event. The study, published in the journal ' Cell Reports' , also found that among people affected by PTSD, the molecular variations appeared to be driven by a number of factors, including the sex and race of the person, and whether the trauma exposure occurred in childhood or adulthood. "The question that our research aims to address is 'What is really different about the PTSD brain?'" corresponding author Frances Champagne of the University of Texas at Austin, US, said. "The study found greater variation in DNA methylation patterns across brain regions in people with PTSD than in people with major depressive disorder. It also revealed considerable differences among individuals with PTSD," Champagne said. The findings could open the door to more individualised treatment options for people with PTSD in the future, the researchers said. A detailed methylation profiling was done of postmortem brains from 302 people -- 101 with PTSD, 100 without psychiatric disorders and 101 with major depressive disorder. Three different regions of brain were analysed in each sample: the prefrontal cortex, involved in higher level functions, including decision-making, the amygdala or the emotional centre of the brain, and the hippocampus, which manages memory. The study uncovered specific changes in the brain linked to PTSD, including a relative reduction in oligodendrocytes -- cells that form the protective covering of neurons (myelin sheath) -- in the amygdala of people with PTSD, particularly in those exposed to trauma in adulthood.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: PTSD was also associated with more pronounced DNA methylation differences in the prefrontal cortex, while major depressive disorder was associated with methylation differences in the amygdala.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #25 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Study finds PTSD-specific brain changes, paving way for personalised treatment

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 06:43:22 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The study uncovered specific changes in the brain linked to PTSD

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A new study has found that DNA methylation, a natural process that acts like a "dimmer switch" to turn genes down or completely off, varies more than expected across different brain regions in genes linked to PTSD. Stress and trauma can leave molecular marks in the brain that may help explain the development of post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD), a mental health disorder in which one experiences flashbacks or nightmares of a terrifying or life-threatening event. The study, published in the journal ' Cell Reports' , also found that among people affected by PTSD, the molecular variations appeared to be driven by a number of factors, including the sex and race of the person, and whether the trauma exposure occurred in childhood or adulthood. "The question that our research aims to address is 'What is really different about the PTSD brain?'" corresponding author Frances Champagne of the University of Texas at Austin, US, said. "The study found greater variation in DNA methylation patterns across brain regions in people with PTSD than in people with major depressive disorder. It also revealed considerable differences among individuals with PTSD," Champagne said. The findings could open the door to more individualised treatment options for people with PTSD in the future, the researchers said. A detailed methylation profiling was done of postmortem brains from 302 people -- 101 with PTSD, 100 without psychiatric disorders and 101 with major depressive disorder. Three different regions of brain were analysed in each sample: the prefrontal cortex, involved in higher level functions, including decision-making, the amygdala or the emotional centre of the brain, and the hippocampus, which manages memory. The study uncovered specific changes in the brain linked to PTSD, including a relative reduction in oligodendrocytes -- cells that form the protective covering of neurons (myelin sheath) -- in the amygdala of people with PTSD, particularly in those exposed to trauma in adulthood.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: PTSD was also associated with more pronounced DNA methylation differences in the prefrontal cortex, while major depressive disorder was associated with methylation differences in the amygdala.

Methylation (Noun)
मेथिलिकरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Methylation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Psychiatric (Adjective)
मानसिक रोगों का — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Psychiatric' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
University (Adjective / Verb)
विश्वविद्यालय — इस अनुच्छेद में 'University' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

A. The study uncovered specific changes in the brain linked to PTSD.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Study finds PTSD-specific brain changes, paving ' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.

D. The author contends that 'Study finds PTSD-specific brain changes, pavi' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The study uncovered specific changes in the brain linked to PTSD." (Hinglish Arth: अध्ययन में पीटीएसडी से जुड़े मस्तिष्क में विशिष्ट परिवर्तनों का पता चला)

C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "PTSD was also associated with more pronounced DNA methylation differences in the prefrontal cortex, while major depressive disorder was associated..." hinglishTracks.en: The COP31 climate summit in Antalya, Türkiye, concluded without agreement on a final cover text after sharp disagreements over fossil fuels, climate finance and emissions reductions.

hinglishTracks.en: Does the failure to reach consensus signal a crisis for global climate diplomacy?

hinglishTracks.en: What does it mean for the future of the Paris Agreement?
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — पेरिस समझौते के भविष्य के लिए इसका क्या मतलब है?। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Agreement' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: समझौता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Agreement' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: And how will countries pursue climate action if progress inside the COP process becomes increasingly difficult?
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — और यदि सीओपी प्रक्रिया के अंदर प्रगति लगातार कठिन हो जाती है तो देश जलवायु कार्रवाई को कैसे आगे बढ़ाएंगे?।

articles.title: Many children may be wearing spectacles with the wrong prescription. What does this mean for their vision?
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The objective is not merely to ensure that children wear spectacles, but that the prescription is appropriate, the lenses are correctly dispensed and their vision is monitored as they grow

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: An incorrect or outdated spectacles prescription can leave a child’s vision inadequately corrected, affecting classroom activities and learning. Regular eye examinations are important because children’s eyesight can change as they grow, and wearing spectacles alone does not ensure that their vision is being corrected properly.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: A study of 5,268 school-going children in north India found that only 23.03% of those prescribed spectacles were using the correct prescription. Inaccurate spectacle power was common, with younger age and longer duration of spectacle use among the associated factors.

📰 Many children may be wearing spectacles with the wrong prescription. What does this mean for their vision?

articles.title: Bausch + Lomb's eye-drop drug fails to reduce pain after laser surgery in trial
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Bausch + Lomb said it plans to discuss the results with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration as it considers next steps for the drug, including a potential late-stage trial

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Bausch + Lomb said on Thursday its experimental eye-drop treatment failed to show a significant reduction in pain over the first 24 hours after laser eye surgery in a mid-stage study. However, the drug showed signs of benefit in secondary and exploratory analyses, including greater pain relief shortly after surgery and faster corneal healing. The mid-stage trial tested two doses of BL1332 in 129 patients undergoing photorefractive keratectomy (PRK), a laser procedure used to correct vision. At six hours after surgery, complete pain relief was reported by 14% and 14.6% of patients receiving the two doses, compared with 3.7% of patients receiving a placebo. Ocular surface pain is a common complication of eye surgery and certain eye diseases. The company said there are currently no approved treatments that directly target its underlying nerve pathways.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Bausch + Lomb said it plans to discuss the results with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration as it considers next steps for the drug, including a potential late-stage trial. Shares of the eye-care company fell 1.4% in extended trading.

hinglishTracks.en: At six hours after surgery, complete pain relief was reported by 14% and 14.6% of patients receiving the two doses, compared with 3.7% of patients receiving a placebo.

hinglishTracks.en: Ocular surface pain is a common complication of eye surgery and certain eye diseases.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — नेत्र सतही दर्द नेत्र शल्य चिकित्सा और कुछ नेत्र रोगों की एक सामान्य जटिलता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Complication' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: उलझन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Complication' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: The company said there are currently no approved treatments that directly target its underlying nerve pathways.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — कंपनी ने कहा कि वर्तमान में कोई अनुमोदित उपचार नहीं है जो सीधे इसके अंतर्निहित तंत्रिका मार्गों को लक्षित करता हो।।

hinglishTracks.en: Bausch + Lomb said it plans to discuss the results with the U.S.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #28 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Bausch + Lomb's eye-drop drug fails to reduce pain after laser surgery in trial

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 06:24:43 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Bausch + Lomb said it plans to discuss the results with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration as it considers next steps for the drug, including a potential late-stage trial

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Bausch + Lomb said on Thursday its experimental eye-drop treatment failed to show a significant reduction in pain over the first 24 hours after laser eye surgery in a mid-stage study. However, the drug showed signs of benefit in secondary and exploratory analyses, including greater pain relief shortly after surgery and faster corneal healing. The mid-stage trial tested two doses of BL1332 in 129 patients undergoing photorefractive keratectomy (PRK), a laser procedure used to correct vision. At six hours after surgery, complete pain relief was reported by 14% and 14.6% of patients receiving the two doses, compared with 3.7% of patients receiving a placebo. Ocular surface pain is a common complication of eye surgery and certain eye diseases. The company said there are currently no approved treatments that directly target its underlying nerve pathways.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Bausch + Lomb said it plans to discuss the results with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration as it considers next steps for the drug, including a potential late-stage trial. Shares of the eye-care company fell 1.4% in extended trading.

A. Bausch + Lomb said it plans to discuss the results with the U.S.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Bausch + Lomb's eye-drop drug fails to reduce pa' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.

articles.title: Antimicrobial overuse could make common infections harder to treat: Health ministry official
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: World AMR Awareness Week is observed from November 18 to 24 every year to improve awareness and understanding of antimicrobial resistance and promote best practices among the public, policymakers and One Health stakeholders

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Misuse and overuse of antimicrobials could undermine decades of medical progress and make even common infections increasingly difficult to treat, a senior health ministry official said on Wednesday, calling for collective action to contain antimicrobial resistance (AMR). Addressing the national observance of World Antimicrobial Resistance Awareness Week 2026 virtually, Union Health Secretary Punya Salila Srivastava described AMR as one of the most serious public health challenges and stressed the need for a coordinated "One Health" approach to tackle it. This year's theme is "One Health, One Action: Prevent AMR Now". She said medicines that have saved countless lives are gradually losing their effectiveness due to misuse and overuse. Srivastava highlighted the interconnectedness of human and animal health, plant and food systems and the environment, noting that improper use of antimicrobials across these sectors contributes to the emergence and spread of resistance. She said the government has accorded high priority to containing AMR, with the National Action Plan on Antimicrobial Resistance 2.0 (NAP AMR 2.0), 2025-2029, providing a framework for surveillance, infection prevention, responsible antimicrobial use, research and coordinated action. The health ministry's National Programme on AMR Containment, coordinated by the National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), focuses on strengthening laboratory capacity for AMR surveillance, infection prevention and control, antimicrobial stewardship and awareness generation, she said. Srivastava urged healthcare professionals to prescribe antibiotics only when clinically indicated and in accordance with treatment guidelines. She also asked pharmacists to ensure appropriate dispensing against valid prescriptions and counsel patients on their correct use. She also advised people against self-medication, sharing antibiotics or using leftover medicines, stressing that antibiotics are not effective against viral infections such as the common cold and influenza.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: More than half of antimicrobial sales in India take place without prescriptions, while nearly half of outpatient antibiotic prescriptions are inappropriate, participants at the event noted.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #29 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Antimicrobial overuse could make common infections harder to treat: Health ministry official

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 06:19:39 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: World AMR Awareness Week is observed from November 18 to 24 every year to improve awareness and understanding of antimicrobial resistance and promote best practices among the public, policymakers and One Health stakeholders

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Misuse and overuse of antimicrobials could undermine decades of medical progress and make even common infections increasingly difficult to treat, a senior health ministry official said on Wednesday, calling for collective action to contain antimicrobial resistance (AMR). Addressing the national observance of World Antimicrobial Resistance Awareness Week 2026 virtually, Union Health Secretary Punya Salila Srivastava described AMR as one of the most serious public health challenges and stressed the need for a coordinated "One Health" approach to tackle it. This year's theme is "One Health, One Action: Prevent AMR Now". She said medicines that have saved countless lives are gradually losing their effectiveness due to misuse and overuse. Srivastava highlighted the interconnectedness of human and animal health, plant and food systems and the environment, noting that improper use of antimicrobials across these sectors contributes to the emergence and spread of resistance. She said the government has accorded high priority to containing AMR, with the National Action Plan on Antimicrobial Resistance 2.0 (NAP AMR 2.0), 2025-2029, providing a framework for surveillance, infection prevention, responsible antimicrobial use, research and coordinated action. The health ministry's National Programme on AMR Containment, coordinated by the National Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), focuses on strengthening laboratory capacity for AMR surveillance, infection prevention and control, antimicrobial stewardship and awareness generation, she said. Srivastava urged healthcare professionals to prescribe antibiotics only when clinically indicated and in accordance with treatment guidelines. She also asked pharmacists to ensure appropriate dispensing against valid prescriptions and counsel patients on their correct use. She also advised people against self-medication, sharing antibiotics or using leftover medicines, stressing that antibiotics are not effective against viral infections such as the common cold and influenza.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: More than half of antimicrobial sales in India take place without prescriptions, while nearly half of outpatient antibiotic prescriptions are inappropriate, participants at the event noted.

पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित।

Antimicrobial (Adjective)
रोगाणुरोधी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Antimicrobial' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Surveillance (Noun)
निगरानी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Surveillance' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Containment (Adjective)
रोकथाम — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Containment' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "Antimicrobial overuse could make common infections harder to treat: Health ministry official", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. World AMR Awareness Week is observed from November 18 to 24 every year to improve awareness and understanding of antimicrobial resistance and promote...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Antimicrobial overuse could make common infectio' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Antimicrobial overuse could make common infec' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Antimicrobial overuse could make common infec' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: England's state-run health service said Monday it has launched the world's largest AI-assisted breast cancer screening trial, which is set to involve nearly 700,000 women over the next three years. The National Health Service (NHS) hailed the new trial as having the potential to transform breast cancer diagnosis, as it announced hundreds of women had been invited to take part at the outset. The £10 million ($13 million) programme will assess if tools assisted by artificial intelligence can help improve early cancer detection in screening, which health officials hope will then free up specialist clinicians' time. The AI-assisted reading tool will assist clinicians in reviewing images collected from routine mammograms, according to the NHS. "This is the biggest AI breast cancer trial in the world," Health Secretary Yvette Cooper said in a statement, lauding the tech's "huge potential" while pledging "proper safeguards" to ensure safety and effectiveness. "If successful, this technology could help women get a breast cancer diagnosis and start treatment much more quickly, giving them the best possible chance of recovery." The trial is being led by the University of Warwick, the University of Cambridge and Cambridge University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust, working closely with NHS England. Women attending routine breast screening at 30 planned sites nationwide will be given details about the trial and participate, unless they choose to opt out. The NHS stressed screening appointments will proceed as normal, but the AI-assisted tool will be used alongside specialists checking the images to look for cancers that are too small to see or feel.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The trial will test whether AI-assisted tools could allow most images to be reviewed by only one specialist, rather than the current two.

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: England's state-run health service said Monday it has launched the world's largest AI-assisted breast cancer screening trial, which is set to involve nearly 700,000 women over the next three years. The National Health Service (NHS) hailed the new trial as having the potential to transform breast cancer diagnosis, as it announced hundreds of women had been invited to take part at the outset. The £10 million ($13 million) programme will assess if tools assisted by artificial intelligence can help improve early cancer detection in screening, which health officials hope will then free up specialist clinicians' time. The AI-assisted reading tool will assist clinicians in reviewing images collected from routine mammograms, according to the NHS. "This is the biggest AI breast cancer trial in the world," Health Secretary Yvette Cooper said in a statement, lauding the tech's "huge potential" while pledging "proper safeguards" to ensure safety and effectiveness. "If successful, this technology could help women get a breast cancer diagnosis and start treatment much more quickly, giving them the best possible chance of recovery." The trial is being led by the University of Warwick, the University of Cambridge and Cambridge University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust, working closely with NHS England. Women attending routine breast screening at 30 planned sites nationwide will be given details about the trial and participate, unless they choose to opt out. The NHS stressed screening appointments will proceed as normal, but the AI-assisted tool will be used alongside specialists checking the images to look for cancers that are too small to see or feel.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The trial will test whether AI-assisted tools could allow most images to be reviewed by only one specialist, rather than the current two.

articles.title: Core accountability: On core sector performance
articles.examRelevance: UPSC, State PSC, SSC & Banking Mains: Deep Analytical Core Summary, Policy Critique, 4 Hinglish Vocab & 2 Analytical Questions
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Even a low base effect could not push India’s oil and gas sectors into growth

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The core sector performance in October is a good example of how statistical distortions can create incorrect assessments of the economy. The 10.9% growth rate, a series high, has been celebrated as a sign of the Indian economy’s strength and resilience. There is, no doubt, an aspect of this has been reflected in the numbers, especially to do with infrastructure creation. However, the much more impactful factor behind the high core sector growth was a low base effect. The overall Index of Core Industries grew just 0.8% in October 2025 and so, in relation, the performance in October 2026 looked that much faster. This low base effect is even starker when looking at individual sectors within the index. The coal sector grew at a blistering 23% in October, more than twice its growth rate in the previous month. Yet, a large part of this was propelled by the fact that the sector had contracted nearly 8.5% last October. The rest of the sector’s growth was driven by demand of the electricity and iron ore sectors, or so the data show. The electricity sector also grew at a series high of nearly 22% in October, but on the back of a near-7% contraction in October last year. This base effect anomaly is likely down to the fact that the festive season starts at different but similar points every year. As such, a more accurate reading of the economy will be possible once the data for November are available.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The construction-related sectors seem to have seen genuine growth, a reflection of the government’s ongoing infrastructure push. The iron ore sector’s growth rate accelerated to a three-month high of 26.4% in October 2026 as compared to a growth of 8.7% in the same month last year. Steel grew at 7.3% versus 9.5% last year, and cement by 15.4% versus 5.2%. The economy’s dependence on government spending is not going to ease in the near future, and might even intensify as higher costs eat into companies’ profit margins. The core sector data once again highlighted a major reason for these higher costs — the oil and gas sectors. The crude oil sector shrank by 4.1%, its 22nd consecutive month of contraction. The natural gas sector, similarly, contracted 7.6%, a series-worst performance and the 28th straight month of contraction. A major reason behind high inflation in India is the underperformance of these two sectors and the resultant dependence on imported fuel. It is time the Petroleum Ministry candidly explains — to Parliament in December or to the public directly — why India’s fuel output has been continuously falling. If it is a matter of a lack of resources underground, that is one thing, but the underperformance of oil and gas public sector undertakings is quite another. Accountability needs to be set.

hinglishTracks.en: The core sector performance in October is a good example of how statistical distortions can create incorrect assessments of the economy.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अक्टूबर में मुख्य क्षेत्र का प्रदर्शन इस बात का अच्छा उदाहरण है कि कैसे सांख्यिकीय विकृतियाँ अर्थव्यवस्था का गलत आकलन कर सकती हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: The 10.9% growth rate, a series high, has been celebrated as a sign of the Indian economy’s strength and resilience.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — 10.9% की विकास दर, जो एक श्रृंखला की उच्चतम दर है, को भारतीय अर्थव्यवस्था की ताकत और लचीलेपन के संकेत के रूप में मनाया गया है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Resilience' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: लचीलापन और मज़बूती — किसी बड़े संकट या मंदी के बाद तेज़ी से वापस उभरने की क्षमता। इसके Synonyms हैं: Robustness, Endurance, Adaptability और Antonyms हैं: Fragility, Vulnerability, Weakness।

hinglishTracks.en: There is, no doubt, an aspect of this has been reflected in the numbers, especially to do with infrastructure creation.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — इसमें कोई संदेह नहीं है, इसका एक पहलू संख्याओं में परिलक्षित हुआ है, विशेषकर बुनियादी ढांचे के निर्माण से संबंधित है।।

hinglishTracks.en: However, the much more impactful factor behind the high core sector growth was a low base effect.

hinglishTracks.en: This low base effect is even starker when looking at individual sectors within the index.

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #1 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Core accountability: On core sector performance

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 01:09:58 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Even a low base effect could not push India’s oil and gas sectors into growth

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The core sector performance in October is a good example of how statistical distortions can create incorrect assessments of the economy. The 10.9% growth rate, a series high, has been celebrated as a sign of the Indian economy’s strength and resilience. There is, no doubt, an aspect of this has been reflected in the numbers, especially to do with infrastructure creation. However, the much more impactful factor behind the high core sector growth was a low base effect. The overall Index of Core Industries grew just 0.8% in October 2025 and so, in relation, the performance in October 2026 looked that much faster. This low base effect is even starker when looking at individual sectors within the index. The coal sector grew at a blistering 23% in October, more than twice its growth rate in the previous month. Yet, a large part of this was propelled by the fact that the sector had contracted nearly 8.5% last October. The rest of the sector’s growth was driven by demand of the electricity and iron ore sectors, or so the data show. The electricity sector also grew at a series high of nearly 22% in October, but on the back of a near-7% contraction in October last year. This base effect anomaly is likely down to the fact that the festive season starts at different but similar points every year. As such, a more accurate reading of the economy will be possible once the data for November are available.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The construction-related sectors seem to have seen genuine growth, a reflection of the government’s ongoing infrastructure push. The iron ore sector’s growth rate accelerated to a three-month high of 26.4% in October 2026 as compared to a growth of 8.7% in the same month last year. Steel grew at 7.3% versus 9.5% last year, and cement by 15.4% versus 5.2%. The economy’s dependence on government spending is not going to ease in the near future, and might even intensify as higher costs eat into companies’ profit margins. The core sector data once again highlighted a major reason for these higher costs — the oil and gas sectors. The crude oil sector shrank by 4.1%, its 22nd consecutive month of contraction. The natural gas sector, similarly, contracted 7.6%, a series-worst performance and the 28th straight month of contraction. A major reason behind high inflation in India is the underperformance of these two sectors and the resultant dependence on imported fuel. It is time the Petroleum Ministry candidly explains — to Parliament in December or to the public directly — why India’s fuel output has been continuously falling. If it is a matter of a lack of resources underground, that is one thing, but the underperformance of oil and gas public sector undertakings is quite another. Accountability needs to be set.

Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Resilience (Noun)
लचीलापन और मज़बूती — किसी बड़े संकट या मंदी के बाद तेज़ी से वापस उभरने की क्षमता।
✓ Syn: Robustness, Endurance, Adaptability  |  ✖ Ant: Fragility, Vulnerability, Weakness
Inflation (Noun)
महंगाई (मुद्रास्फीति) — जब बाज़ार में वस्तुओं के दाम बढ़ें और रुपये की खरीद शक्ति कम हो जाए।
✓ Syn: Price-escalation, Hyperinflation, Dearness  |  ✖ Ant: Deflation, Disinflation, Recession
Underperformance (Adjective / Verb)
खराब प्रदर्शन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Underperformance' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

A. Even a low base effect could not push India’s oil and gas sectors into growth.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Core accountability: On core sector performance' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Core accountability: On core sector performan' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Core accountability: On core sector performan' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.

B. If it is a matter of a lack of resources underground, that is one thing, but the underperformance of oil and gas public sector undertakings is quite...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "If it is a matter of a lack of resources underground, that is one thing, but the underperformance of oil and gas public sector undertakings is quite..." (Hinglish Arth: यदि यह भूमिगत संसाधनों की कमी का मामला है, तो यह एक बात है, लेकिन तेल और गैस सार्वजनिक क्षेत्र के उपक्रमों का खराब प्रदर्शन बिल्कुल अलग है।)

articles.title: Paper tiger: On the Green India Mission
articles.examRelevance: UPSC, State PSC, SSC & Banking Mains: Deep Analytical Core Summary, Policy Critique, 4 Hinglish Vocab & 2 Analytical Questions
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Climate action has to be timely, with adequate resources and monitoring

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: That all was not well with the Green India Mission was clear even before its approval. After the UPA-I government announced it in 2008, the Ministry of Rural Development had objected to its financial design much before the Union Cabinet approved it in 2014. But the Environment Ministry proceeded anyway and retained largely the same arrangement when it revised the Mission in 2021. Following the Comptroller and Auditor General’s report, on November 19, the Public Accounts Committee (PAC) upbraided the Ministry for the Mission’s virtual failure and for still not having issued the implementation guidelines for the revised form. The original 10-year vision was to expand forest and tree cover by 5 million hectares (mha), improve forest quality on another 5 mha, improve forest-related livelihoods for 3 million households, and sequester up to 60 million tonnes of carbon dioxide a year. The outlay was ₹46,000 crore. In 2014, the Cabinet approved ₹13,000 crore for 1.4 mha each of the first two objectives by 2018, but to be supported to the tune of 81.5% by Compensatory Afforestation Fund Management and Planning Authority (CAMPA), National Afforestation Programme (NAP), and MGNREGS funds. In 2021-22, the Ministry folded the NAP into the Mission and, in mid-2025, unveiled a revised version with an allocation of ₹12,190 crore to improve forest cover on 25 mha by 2030, including 24 mha through other schemes. The government had thus expanded the primary target but left the Mission responsible for only 1 mha.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Together with the CAMPA, NAP, and MGNREGS funds never materialising, it is no surprise that the programmes to improve forest quality and forest cover have respectively fallen short by 91.8% and 97.5% vis-à-vis the 2014 target. The Environment Ministry had assembled a large programme around resources that it knew it could not control. Pro-climate work in practice ought to span government schemes to deliver action and justice, and the Ministry ought to have formalised the division of responsibilities and accounting system. The PAC’s new demand that the Ministry submit an implementation timetable is insufficient. From the Jal Shakti Abhiyan in 2019 to the Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan in 2024, the government has often floated new programmes banking significantly on funds from existing schemes — an untenable policy when the latter also have their own obligations. And if the VB-G RAM G scheme was to also advance climate justice, the government should not have undermined the erstwhile demand-driven funding model and shifted more financial responsibility to the States. Climate action has to be timely, for which the Union government must dedicate adequate resources and proactively ensure that its initiatives are implemented.

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — लेकिन पर्यावरण मंत्रालय फिर भी आगे बढ़ा और 2021 में मिशन को संशोधित करते समय मोटे तौर पर वही व्यवस्था बरकरार रखी।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Environmental' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित। इसके Synonyms हैं: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural और Antonyms हैं: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic।

hinglishTracks.en: Following the Comptroller and Auditor General’s report, on November 19, the Public Accounts Committee (PAC) upbraided the Ministry for the Mission’s virtual failure and for still not having issued the implementation guidelines for the revised form.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — नियंत्रक एवं महालेखा परीक्षक की रिपोर्ट के बाद, 19 नवंबर को, लोक लेखा समिति (पीएसी) ने मिशन की आभासी विफलता और संशोधित फॉर्म के लिए कार्यान्वयन दिशानिर्देश जारी नहीं करने के लिए मंत्रालय को फटकार लगाई।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Implementation' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना। इसके Synonyms हैं: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment और Antonyms हैं: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation।

hinglishTracks.en: The original 10-year vision was to expand forest and tree cover by 5 million hectares (mha), improve forest quality on another 5 mha, improve forest-related livelihoods for 3 million households, and sequester up to 60 million tonnes of carbon dioxide a year.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — मूल 10-वर्षीय दृष्टिकोण वन और वृक्ष आवरण को 5 मिलियन हेक्टेयर (एमएचए) तक विस्तारित करना, अन्य 5 एमएचए पर वन की गुणवत्ता में सुधार करना, 3 मिलियन परिवारों के लिए वन-संबंधित आजीविका में सुधार करना और प्रति वर्ष 60 मिलियन टन कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड को अलग करना था।।

hinglishTracks.en: In 2014, the Cabinet approved ₹13,000 crore for 1.4 mha each of the first two objectives by 2018, but to be supported to the tune of 81.5% by Compensatory Afforestation Fund Management and Planning Authority (CAMPA), National Afforestation Programme (NAP), and MGNREGS funds.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — 2014 में, कैबिनेट ने 2018 तक पहले दो उद्देश्यों में से प्रत्येक 1.4 एमएचए के लिए ₹13,000 करोड़ की मंजूरी दी, लेकिन प्रतिपूरक वनीकरण निधि प्रबंधन और योजना प्राधिकरण (सीएएमपीए), राष्ट्रीय वनीकरण कार्यक्रम (एनएपी), और एमजीएनआरईजीएस फंड द्वारा 81.5% तक का समर्थन किया जाएगा।।

hinglishTracks.en: In 2021-22, the Ministry folded the NAP into the Mission and, in mid-2025, unveiled a revised version with an allocation of ₹12,190 crore to improve forest cover on 25 mha by 2030, including 24 mha through other schemes.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — 2021-22 में, मंत्रालय ने एनएपी को मिशन में शामिल कर लिया और 2025 के मध्य में, 2030 तक 25 एमएचए पर वन क्षेत्र में सुधार करने के लिए ₹12,190 करोड़ के आवंटन के साथ एक संशोधित संस्करण का अनावरण किया, जिसमें अन्य योजनाओं के माध्यम से 24 एमएचए भी शामिल था।।

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — व्यवहार में जलवायु समर्थक कार्य में कार्रवाई और न्याय प्रदान करने के लिए सरकारी योजनाओं का विस्तार होना चाहिए, और मंत्रालय को जिम्मेदारियों और लेखा प्रणाली के विभाजन को औपचारिक रूप देना चाहिए।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Accountability' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता। इसके Synonyms हैं: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability और Antonyms हैं: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility।

hinglishTracks.en: The PAC’s new demand that the Ministry submit an implementation timetable is insufficient.

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #2 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Paper tiger: On the Green India Mission

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 01:07:54 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Climate action has to be timely, with adequate resources and monitoring

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: That all was not well with the Green India Mission was clear even before its approval. After the UPA-I government announced it in 2008, the Ministry of Rural Development had objected to its financial design much before the Union Cabinet approved it in 2014. But the Environment Ministry proceeded anyway and retained largely the same arrangement when it revised the Mission in 2021. Following the Comptroller and Auditor General’s report, on November 19, the Public Accounts Committee (PAC) upbraided the Ministry for the Mission’s virtual failure and for still not having issued the implementation guidelines for the revised form. The original 10-year vision was to expand forest and tree cover by 5 million hectares (mha), improve forest quality on another 5 mha, improve forest-related livelihoods for 3 million households, and sequester up to 60 million tonnes of carbon dioxide a year. The outlay was ₹46,000 crore. In 2014, the Cabinet approved ₹13,000 crore for 1.4 mha each of the first two objectives by 2018, but to be supported to the tune of 81.5% by Compensatory Afforestation Fund Management and Planning Authority (CAMPA), National Afforestation Programme (NAP), and MGNREGS funds. In 2021-22, the Ministry folded the NAP into the Mission and, in mid-2025, unveiled a revised version with an allocation of ₹12,190 crore to improve forest cover on 25 mha by 2030, including 24 mha through other schemes. The government had thus expanded the primary target but left the Mission responsible for only 1 mha.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Together with the CAMPA, NAP, and MGNREGS funds never materialising, it is no surprise that the programmes to improve forest quality and forest cover have respectively fallen short by 91.8% and 97.5% vis-à-vis the 2014 target. The Environment Ministry had assembled a large programme around resources that it knew it could not control. Pro-climate work in practice ought to span government schemes to deliver action and justice, and the Ministry ought to have formalised the division of responsibilities and accounting system. The PAC’s new demand that the Ministry submit an implementation timetable is insufficient. From the Jal Shakti Abhiyan in 2019 to the Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan in 2024, the government has often floated new programmes banking significantly on funds from existing schemes — an untenable policy when the latter also have their own obligations. And if the VB-G RAM G scheme was to also advance climate justice, the government should not have undermined the erstwhile demand-driven funding model and shifted more financial responsibility to the States. Climate action has to be timely, for which the Union government must dedicate adequate resources and proactively ensure that its initiatives are implemented.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Environmental (Adjective)
पर्यावरण, प्रकृति और हमारे पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र (Ecosystem) से संबंधित।
✓ Syn: Ecological, Biospheric, Natural  |  ✖ Ant: Industrial, Polluting, Synthetic
Implementation (Noun)
क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना।
✓ Syn: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment  |  ✖ Ant: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation
Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Responsibility (Noun)
ज़िम्मेदारी — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Responsibility' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above ✍️ Editorial & Opinion passage on "Paper tiger: On the Green India Mission", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Climate action has to be timely, with adequate resources and monitoring.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Paper tiger: On the Green India Mission' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Paper tiger: On the Green India Mission' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Paper tiger: On the Green India Mission' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Climate action has to be timely, with adequate resources and monitoring." (Hinglish Arth: पर्याप्त संसाधनों और निगरानी के साथ जलवायु कार्रवाई समय पर होनी चाहिए)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Paper tiger: On the Green India Mission"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Climate action has to be timely, for which the Union government must dedicate adequate resources and proactively ensure that its initiatives are...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Climate action has to be timely, for which the Union government must dedicate adequate resources and proactively ensure that its initiatives are..." (Hinglish Arth: जलवायु कार्रवाई समय पर होनी चाहिए, जिसके लिए केंद्र सरकार को पर्याप्त संसाधन समर्पित करने चाहिए और सक्रिय रूप से यह सुनिश्चित करना चाहिए कि उसकी पहल लागू हो।)

In 2021-22, the Ministry folded the NAP into the Mission and, in mid-2025, unveiled a revised version with an allocation of ₹12,190 crore to improve forest cover on 25 mha by 2030, including 24 mha through other schemes. The government had thus expanded the primary target but left the Mission responsible for only 1 mha.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Together with the CAMPA, NAP, and MGNREGS funds never materialising, it is no surprise that the programmes to improve forest quality and forest cover have respectively fallen short by 91.8% and 97.5% vis-à-vis the 2014 target. The Environment Ministry had assembled a large programme around resources that it knew it could not control. Pro-climate work in practice ought to span government schemes to deliver action and justice, and the Ministry ought to have formalised the division of responsibilities and accounting system. The PAC’s new demand that the Ministry submit an implementation timetable is insufficient. From the Jal Shakti Abhiyan in 2019 to the Dharti Aaba Janjatiya Gram Utkarsh Abhiyan in 2024, the government has often floated new programmes banking significantly on funds from existing schemes — an untenable policy when the latter also have their own obligations. And if the VB-G RAM G scheme was to also advance climate justice, the government should not have undermined the erstwhile demand-driven funding model and shifted more financial responsibility to the States. Climate action has to be timely, for which the Union government must dedicate adequate resources and proactively ensure that its initiatives are implemented.

articles.title: Incomplete remedies: On Special Summary Revision of electoral rolls
articles.examRelevance: UPSC, State PSC, SSC & Banking Mains: Deep Analytical Core Summary, Policy Critique, 4 Hinglish Vocab & 2 Analytical Questions
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The ECI offers relief to a section of deleted electors but SIR’s flaws remain

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Following the Special Summary Revision (SSR) by the Election Commission of India (ECI) in some States that had undergone the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) , mostly in Phases 1 and 2, some 74 lakh names were added onto the electoral rolls. This meant that the electorate in those 13 States, that had shrunk from 49.61 crore to 45.22 crore after the SIR, has now gone up to 45.96 crore. The ECI has extended the SSR to States and UTs in Phase 3. As before, it requires no proof of citizenship or mapping to older rolls, and insists on personal notice before any deletion other than of the dead. It also directs Electoral Registration Officers (EROs) to cross-verify deletions personally wherever they exceed 2% of a polling station’s electors. Draft deletions in Phase 3 of the SIR averaged 17% , and reached 32.8% in Delhi . The ECI also offered another opportunity to electors deleted by the SIR in the seven States and UTs where it is still underway, such as Delhi and Maharashtra, to return to the rolls. Electors who did not return their forms can do so now, explaining the delay, and those who moved within the State can return through the enumeration form with proof of their new address. EROs will process these forms under Rule 21(1) of the Registration of Electors Rules, 1960, and restore the elector’s old EPIC number. These “corrective” measures follow the Supreme Court’s observation on October 28 that forcing deleted electors to re-enrol through Form 6, meant for new voters, was an “error”. The ECI’s use of remedies that existed in the registration rules is a tacit admission that it went wrong during the SIR. But the measures are limited. They reach roughly 4.5 crore of the 13.37 crore struck off the draft rolls and do not cover electors who moved out of their States. Electors in States where the SIR has concluded, including Bihar and West Bengal, which have already voted on the SIR rolls, can return only through the SSR, by filing Form 6 as new voters, with fresh EPIC numbers and no record that they were ever on the roll. In essence, the structure of the SIR remains intact. Electors must still provide details from “the last SIR”, and those whose details are unavailable or do not match will be asked for documents in a manner that amounts to a citizenship test. The legality of the ludicrous “logical discrepancy” checks remains unaddressed. The 2002-03 special revision offered a better way. Those who had shifted homes were enumerated door to door at their new addresses. The Supreme Court must direct the ECI to return to that model.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Election Commission of India / Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls / election / India

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #5 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Incomplete remedies: On Special Summary Revision of electoral rolls

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 07:28:59 PM IST
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The ECI offers relief to a section of deleted electors but SIR’s flaws remain

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Following the Special Summary Revision (SSR) by the Election Commission of India (ECI) in some States that had undergone the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) , mostly in Phases 1 and 2, some 74 lakh names were added onto the electoral rolls. This meant that the electorate in those 13 States, that had shrunk from 49.61 crore to 45.22 crore after the SIR, has now gone up to 45.96 crore. The ECI has extended the SSR to States and UTs in Phase 3. As before, it requires no proof of citizenship or mapping to older rolls, and insists on personal notice before any deletion other than of the dead. It also directs Electoral Registration Officers (EROs) to cross-verify deletions personally wherever they exceed 2% of a polling station’s electors. Draft deletions in Phase 3 of the SIR averaged 17% , and reached 32.8% in Delhi . The ECI also offered another opportunity to electors deleted by the SIR in the seven States and UTs where it is still underway, such as Delhi and Maharashtra, to return to the rolls. Electors who did not return their forms can do so now, explaining the delay, and those who moved within the State can return through the enumeration form with proof of their new address. EROs will process these forms under Rule 21(1) of the Registration of Electors Rules, 1960, and restore the elector’s old EPIC number. These “corrective” measures follow the Supreme Court’s observation on October 28 that forcing deleted electors to re-enrol through Form 6, meant for new voters, was an “error”. The ECI’s use of remedies that existed in the registration rules is a tacit admission that it went wrong during the SIR. But the measures are limited. They reach roughly 4.5 crore of the 13.37 crore struck off the draft rolls and do not cover electors who moved out of their States. Electors in States where the SIR has concluded, including Bihar and West Bengal, which have already voted on the SIR rolls, can return only through the SSR, by filing Form 6 as new voters, with fresh EPIC numbers and no record that they were ever on the roll. In essence, the structure of the SIR remains intact. Electors must still provide details from “the last SIR”, and those whose details are unavailable or do not match will be asked for documents in a manner that amounts to a citizenship test. The legality of the ludicrous “logical discrepancy” checks remains unaddressed. The 2002-03 special revision offered a better way. Those who had shifted homes were enumerated door to door at their new addresses. The Supreme Court must direct the ECI to return to that model.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Election Commission of India / Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls / election / India

articles.title: Talks without peace: On Russia, Ukraine, U.S. talks
articles.examRelevance: UPSC, State PSC, SSC & Banking Mains: Deep Analytical Core Summary, Policy Critique, 4 Hinglish Vocab & 2 Analytical Questions
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Europe must be part of any settlement on the Ukraine war

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The trilateral negotiations in Abu Dhabi between Russia, Ukraine and the U.S. earlier this month failed to produce a major breakthrough or bridge the wide gap between Kyiv and Moscow. Yet, they were a good beginning towards finding a political settlement to Europe’s longest war since the Second World War . In the two-day talks, hosted by the U.S., the warring sides agreed on some humanitarian measures, including prisoner exchange. U.S. representatives Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff met Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow after the talks to discuss the proposal. In the next stage, U.S., Ukrainian and European officials will meet in Berlin to discuss a coordinated European and Ukrainian position towards the peace process. As of now, Russian and Ukrainian positions remain far apart. Russia demands Ukraine withdraw from the territories of Donbas it still controls to stop attacks. Russia also wants to introduce limits to Ukrainian military capabilities and Kyiv to declare neutrality (give up its NATO ambitions). Ukraine, on the other hand, has rejected making any territorial concessions for a settlement and asked for security guarantees from the West so that Russia would not attack the country again. That Ukraine survived Russia’s invasion and continued to resist Russian forces for almost five years is no small feat. But it has also paid a huge price for its resistance. The country has lost more than 20% of its territory. Millions have fled, while men of fighting age are being drafted into the military . Ukraine’s economy is kept afloat by European support, while its military continues to rely on NATO for weapons and other supplies. Until recently, the West stood united in its support for Ukraine against Russia, but that unity has since begun to fray. U.S. President Donald Trump, who has lifted sanctions on Russian diesel, is seeking to reset Washington’s ties with Moscow . European leaders, who initially sought to isolate Russia, have also started reestablishing contacts with the Kremlin. In October, Finnish and Norwegian leaders held direct talks with Mr. Putin. To be sure, Ukraine’s long-range strikes can hurt Russia, as the recent attack on the Kerch Bridge demonstrated. But such strikes are unlikely to change the Kremlin’s thinking about the war. As the conflict drags on, Ukraine’s position is weakening, and its allies are growing increasingly divided. After almost five years, Russia has failed to take a decisive victory. Ukraine does not have a credible path towards victory either. A diplomatic settlement, therefore, is the only way forward. The Abu Dhabi talks recognised this reality. But for the process to be meaningful, Europe must also be brought to the negotiating table.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: World / Ukraine / USA / Russia-Ukraine Crisis / war / war

hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — रूस, यूक्रेन और अमेरिका के बीच अबू धाबी में त्रिपक्षीय वार्ता। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Trilateral' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: त्रिपक्षीय — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Trilateral' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: earlier this month failed to produce a major breakthrough or bridge the wide gap between Kyiv and Moscow.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — इस महीने की शुरुआत में कोई बड़ी सफलता हासिल करने या कीव और मॉस्को के बीच व्यापक अंतर को पाटने में विफल रही।।

hinglishTracks.en: Yet, they were a good beginning towards finding a political settlement to Europe’s longest war since the Second World War .
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — फिर भी, वे द्वितीय विश्व युद्ध के बाद यूरोप के सबसे लंबे युद्ध का राजनीतिक समाधान खोजने की दिशा में एक अच्छी शुरुआत थे।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Settlement' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: बस्ती — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Settlement' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: In the two-day talks, hosted by the U.S., the warring sides agreed on some humanitarian measures, including prisoner exchange.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — अमेरिका द्वारा आयोजित दो दिवसीय वार्ता में, युद्धरत पक्ष कैदियों की अदला-बदली सहित कुछ मानवीय उपायों पर सहमत हुए।।

hinglishTracks.en: representatives Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff met Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow after the talks to discuss the proposal.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — प्रस्ताव पर चर्चा के लिए प्रतिनिधि जेरेड कुशनर और स्टीव विटकॉफ़ ने वार्ता के बाद मॉस्को में रूसी राष्ट्रपति व्लादिमीर पुतिन से मुलाकात की।।

hinglishTracks.en: In the next stage, U.S., Ukrainian and European officials will meet in Berlin to discuss a coordinated European and Ukrainian position towards the peace process.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अगले चरण में, अमेरिकी, यूक्रेनी और यूरोपीय अधिकारी शांति प्रक्रिया के प्रति समन्वित यूरोपीय और यूक्रेनी स्थिति पर चर्चा करने के लिए बर्लिन में मिलेंगे।।

hinglishTracks.en: As of now, Russian and Ukrainian positions remain far apart.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — अभी तक, रूसी और यूक्रेनी स्थिति बहुत दूर हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: Russia demands Ukraine withdraw from the territories of Donbas it still controls to stop attacks.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — रूस ने हमलों को रोकने के लिए यूक्रेन से डोनबास के उन क्षेत्रों से हटने की मांग की है जिन पर उसका अभी भी नियंत्रण है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Territorial' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: प्रादेशिक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Territorial' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Russia also wants to introduce limits to Ukrainian military capabilities and Kyiv to declare neutrality (give up its NATO ambitions).
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — रूस भी यूक्रेनी सैन्य क्षमताओं पर सीमाएं लगाना चाहता है और कीव तटस्थता की घोषणा करना चाहता है (अपनी नाटो महत्वाकांक्षाओं को छोड़ना)।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Neutrality' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: तटस्थता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Neutrality' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Significant, Substantial, Strategic और Antonyms हैं: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial।

hinglishTracks.en: Ukraine, on the other hand, has rejected making any territorial concessions for a settlement and asked for security guarantees from the West so that Russia would not attack the country again.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — दूसरी ओर, यूक्रेन ने समझौते के लिए कोई भी क्षेत्रीय रियायत देने से इनकार कर दिया है और पश्चिम से सुरक्षा गारंटी मांगी है ताकि रूस देश पर दोबारा हमला न करे।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Territorial' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: प्रादेशिक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Territorial' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: That Ukraine survived Russia’s invasion and continued to resist Russian forces for almost five years is no small feat.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — यूक्रेन रूस के आक्रमण से बच गया और लगभग पाँच वर्षों तक रूसी सेनाओं का विरोध करता रहा, यह कोई छोटी उपलब्धि नहीं है।।

hinglishTracks.en: But it has also paid a huge price for its resistance.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — लेकिन इसने अपने प्रतिरोध की भारी कीमत भी चुकाई है।।

hinglishTracks.en: The country has lost more than 20% of its territory.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — देश ने अपना 20% से अधिक क्षेत्र खो दिया है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Territorial' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: प्रादेशिक — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Territorial' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: Millions have fled, while men of fighting age are being drafted into the military .
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — लाखों लोग भाग गए हैं, जबकि लड़ने की उम्र के लोगों को सेना में शामिल किया जा रहा है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Ukraine’s economy is kept afloat by European support, while its military continues to rely on NATO for weapons and other supplies.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — यूक्रेन की अर्थव्यवस्था यूरोपीय समर्थन से चलती रहती है, जबकि इसकी सेना हथियारों और अन्य आपूर्ति के लिए नाटो पर निर्भर रहती है।।

hinglishTracks.en: Until recently, the West stood united in its support for Ukraine against Russia, but that unity has since begun to fray.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — हाल तक, पश्चिम रूस के ख़िलाफ़ यूक्रेन के समर्थन में एकजुट था, लेकिन तब से वह एकता ख़त्म होने लगी है।।

hinglishTracks.en: President Donald Trump, who has lifted sanctions on Russian diesel, is seeking to reset Washington’s ties with Moscow .
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रम्प, जिन्होंने रूसी डीजल पर प्रतिबंध हटा दिया है, मास्को के साथ वाशिंगटन के संबंधों को फिर से स्थापित करने की कोशिश कर रहे हैं।।

hinglishTracks.en: European leaders, who initially sought to isolate Russia, have also started reestablishing contacts with the Kremlin.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — यूरोपीय नेता, जिन्होंने शुरू में रूस को अलग-थलग करने की कोशिश की थी, उन्होंने भी क्रेमलिन के साथ फिर से संपर्क स्थापित करना शुरू कर दिया है।।

hinglishTracks.en: In October, Finnish and Norwegian leaders held direct talks with Mr.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — अक्टूबर में, फिनिश और नॉर्वेजियन नेताओं ने श्री के साथ सीधी बातचीत की।।

hinglishTracks.en: To be sure, Ukraine’s long-range strikes can hurt Russia, as the recent attack on the Kerch Bridge demonstrated.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — निश्चित रूप से, यूक्रेन के लंबी दूरी के हमले रूस को नुकसान पहुंचा सकते हैं, जैसा कि केर्च ब्रिज पर हाल के हमले से पता चला है।।

hinglishTracks.en: But such strikes are unlikely to change the Kremlin’s thinking about the war.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — लेकिन इस तरह के हमलों से क्रेमलिन की युद्ध के बारे में सोच बदलने की संभावना नहीं है।।

hinglishTracks.en: As the conflict drags on, Ukraine’s position is weakening, and its allies are growing increasingly divided.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — जैसे-जैसे संघर्ष बढ़ता जा रहा है, यूक्रेन की स्थिति कमज़ोर होती जा रही है और उसके सहयोगियों में फूट बढ़ती जा रही है।।

hinglishTracks.en: After almost five years, Russia has failed to take a decisive victory.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये, एग्जाम के नज़रिये से यह पॉइंट बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है — करीब पांच साल बाद रूस निर्णायक जीत हासिल करने में नाकाम रहा है.।

hinglishTracks.en: Ukraine does not have a credible path towards victory either.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: चलिए, अब इस अगली लाइन का असली मतलब देखते हैं — यूक्रेन के पास जीत की दिशा में कोई विश्वसनीय रास्ता भी नहीं है।।

hinglishTracks.en: A diplomatic settlement, therefore, is the only way forward.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: देखिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का सीधा सा मतलब समझिये — इसलिए, कूटनीतिक समझौता ही आगे बढ़ने का एकमात्र रास्ता है।। नोट कर लीजिये दोस्तों, इस लाइन का वर्ड 'Settlement' एग्जाम के लिए बहुत महत्वपूर्ण है! इसका अर्थ है: बस्ती — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Settlement' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है। इसके Synonyms हैं: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive और Antonyms हैं: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile।

hinglishTracks.en: The Abu Dhabi talks recognised this reality.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: ज़रा ध्यान दीजियेगा, यहाँ मुख्य बात यह है कि — अबू धाबी वार्ता ने इस वास्तविकता को पहचाना।।

hinglishTracks.en: But for the process to be meaningful, Europe must also be brought to the negotiating table.
hinglishTracks.hiExplanation: आसान हिंग्लिश भाषा में इसे समझें तो — लेकिन इस प्रक्रिया को सार्थक बनाने के लिए यूरोप को भी बातचीत की मेज पर लाना होगा।।

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #6 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Talks without peace: On Russia, Ukraine, U.S. talks

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 07:28:59 PM IST
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Europe must be part of any settlement on the Ukraine war

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The trilateral negotiations in Abu Dhabi between Russia, Ukraine and the U.S. earlier this month failed to produce a major breakthrough or bridge the wide gap between Kyiv and Moscow. Yet, they were a good beginning towards finding a political settlement to Europe’s longest war since the Second World War . In the two-day talks, hosted by the U.S., the warring sides agreed on some humanitarian measures, including prisoner exchange. U.S. representatives Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff met Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow after the talks to discuss the proposal. In the next stage, U.S., Ukrainian and European officials will meet in Berlin to discuss a coordinated European and Ukrainian position towards the peace process. As of now, Russian and Ukrainian positions remain far apart. Russia demands Ukraine withdraw from the territories of Donbas it still controls to stop attacks. Russia also wants to introduce limits to Ukrainian military capabilities and Kyiv to declare neutrality (give up its NATO ambitions). Ukraine, on the other hand, has rejected making any territorial concessions for a settlement and asked for security guarantees from the West so that Russia would not attack the country again. That Ukraine survived Russia’s invasion and continued to resist Russian forces for almost five years is no small feat. But it has also paid a huge price for its resistance. The country has lost more than 20% of its territory. Millions have fled, while men of fighting age are being drafted into the military . Ukraine’s economy is kept afloat by European support, while its military continues to rely on NATO for weapons and other supplies. Until recently, the West stood united in its support for Ukraine against Russia, but that unity has since begun to fray. U.S. President Donald Trump, who has lifted sanctions on Russian diesel, is seeking to reset Washington’s ties with Moscow . European leaders, who initially sought to isolate Russia, have also started reestablishing contacts with the Kremlin. In October, Finnish and Norwegian leaders held direct talks with Mr. Putin. To be sure, Ukraine’s long-range strikes can hurt Russia, as the recent attack on the Kerch Bridge demonstrated. But such strikes are unlikely to change the Kremlin’s thinking about the war. As the conflict drags on, Ukraine’s position is weakening, and its allies are growing increasingly divided. After almost five years, Russia has failed to take a decisive victory. Ukraine does not have a credible path towards victory either. A diplomatic settlement, therefore, is the only way forward. The Abu Dhabi talks recognised this reality. But for the process to be meaningful, Europe must also be brought to the negotiating table.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: World / Ukraine / USA / Russia-Ukraine Crisis / war / war

articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: Europe must be part of any settlement on the Ukraine war
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The trilateral negotiations in Abu Dhabi between Russia, Ukraine and the U.S. earlier this month failed to produce a major breakthrough or bridge the wide gap between Kyiv and Moscow. Yet, they were a good beginning towards finding a political settlement to Europe’s longest war since the Second World War . In the two-day talks, hosted by the U.S., the warring sides agreed on some humanitarian measures, including prisoner exchange. U.S. representatives Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff met Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow after the talks to discuss the proposal. In the next stage, U.S., Ukrainian and European officials will meet in Berlin to discuss a coordinated European and Ukrainian position towards the peace process. As of now, Russian and Ukrainian positions remain far apart. Russia demands Ukraine withdraw from the territories of Donbas it still controls to stop attacks. Russia also wants to introduce limits to Ukrainian military capabilities and Kyiv to declare neutrality (give up its NATO ambitions). Ukraine, on the other hand, has rejected making any territorial concessions for a settlement and asked for security guarantees from the West so that Russia would not attack the country again. That Ukraine survived Russia’s invasion and continued to resist Russian forces for almost five years is no small feat. But it has also paid a huge price for its resistance. The country has lost more than 20% of its territory. Millions have fled, while men of fighting age are being drafted into the military . Ukraine’s economy is kept afloat by European support, while its military continues to rely on NATO for weapons and other supplies. Until recently, the West stood united in its support for Ukraine against Russia, but that unity has since begun to fray. U.S. President Donald Trump, who has lifted sanctions on Russian diesel, is seeking to reset Washington’s ties with Moscow . European leaders, who initially sought to isolate Russia, have also started reestablishing contacts with the Kremlin. In October, Finnish and Norwegian leaders held direct talks with Mr. Putin. To be sure, Ukraine’s long-range strikes can hurt Russia, as the recent attack on the Kerch Bridge demonstrated. But such strikes are unlikely to change the Kremlin’s thinking about the war. As the conflict drags on, Ukraine’s position is weakening, and its allies are growing increasingly divided. After almost five years, Russia has failed to take a decisive victory. Ukraine does not have a credible path towards victory either. A diplomatic settlement, therefore, is the only way forward. The Abu Dhabi talks recognised this reality. But for the process to be meaningful, Europe must also be brought to the negotiating table.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: World / Ukraine / USA / Russia-Ukraine Crisis / war / war
