articles.title: Raut alleges BJP offers funds to secure support for Delimitation Bill
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Sanjay Raut alleged during the conference that an MP would receive ₹150 crore upon breaking away from a party to support the Delimitation Bill without facing disqualification

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Sanjay Raut alleged at a conference on November 22 that the Bharatiya Janata Party is offering ₹150 crore to Members of Parliament to gain backing for the Delimitation Bill, while also alleging that the government is delaying the session of the Parliament because it lacks the support of 40 to 45 MPs to pass the legislation and is attempting to pressure parties or buy lawmakers. Editorial | Deservedly dead: On the defeat of the Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill, 2026 The Delimitation Bill contains a provision to increase the number of seats in the Lok Sabha to 850, which has resulted in a dispute between the National Democratic Alliance and the INDIA bloc, where the National Democratic Alliance states that carrying out delimitation is required by the Constitution to reflect data from a census and to enable reservation for women, while the Opposition demands implementation of 33% reservation for women within a Lok Sabha that contains 543 members. Sanjay Raut alleged during the conference that an MP would receive ₹150 crore upon breaking away from a party to support the Delimitation Bill without facing disqualification, and he claimed that a Minister from Maharashtra has taken responsibility for the situation and promised to provide funds for the purpose, further alleging that the government has delayed the session of the Parliament because it does not concern itself with the nation, the Constitution, or the Parliament, adding that if parties do not defect, MPs would be purchased, and he referenced a statement regarding a rate on an exchange of ₹150 crore per MP.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Shiv Sena-Uddhav Balasaheb Thackeray / Bharatiya Janata Party / National Democratic Alliance

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Raut alleges BJP offers funds to secure support for Delimitation Bill

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 01:48:09 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Sanjay Raut alleged during the conference that an MP would receive ₹150 crore upon breaking away from a party to support the Delimitation Bill without facing disqualification

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Sanjay Raut alleged at a conference on November 22 that the Bharatiya Janata Party is offering ₹150 crore to Members of Parliament to gain backing for the Delimitation Bill, while also alleging that the government is delaying the session of the Parliament because it lacks the support of 40 to 45 MPs to pass the legislation and is attempting to pressure parties or buy lawmakers. Editorial | Deservedly dead: On the defeat of the Constitution (131st Amendment) Bill, 2026 The Delimitation Bill contains a provision to increase the number of seats in the Lok Sabha to 850, which has resulted in a dispute between the National Democratic Alliance and the INDIA bloc, where the National Democratic Alliance states that carrying out delimitation is required by the Constitution to reflect data from a census and to enable reservation for women, while the Opposition demands implementation of 33% reservation for women within a Lok Sabha that contains 543 members. Sanjay Raut alleged during the conference that an MP would receive ₹150 crore upon breaking away from a party to support the Delimitation Bill without facing disqualification, and he claimed that a Minister from Maharashtra has taken responsibility for the situation and promised to provide funds for the purpose, further alleging that the government has delayed the session of the Parliament because it does not concern itself with the nation, the Constitution, or the Parliament, adding that if parties do not defect, MPs would be purchased, and he referenced a statement regarding a rate on an exchange of ₹150 crore per MP.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Shiv Sena-Uddhav Balasaheb Thackeray / Bharatiya Janata Party / National Democratic Alliance

Implementation (Noun)
क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना।
✓ Syn: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment  |  ✖ Ant: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation
Constitutional (Adjective)
संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।
✓ Syn: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful  |  ✖ Ant: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary
Disqualification (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Disqualification' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Responsibility (Noun)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Responsibility' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Raut alleges BJP offers funds to secure support for Delimitation Bill", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Sanjay Raut alleged during the conference that an MP would receive ₹150 crore upon breaking away from a party to support the Delimitation Bill...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Raut alleges BJP offers funds to secure support ' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Raut alleges BJP offers funds to secure suppo' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Raut alleges BJP offers funds to secure suppo' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Sanjay Raut alleged during the conference that an MP would receive ₹150 crore upon breaking away from a party to support the Delimitation Bill..." Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Raut alleges BJP offers funds to secure support for Delimitation Bill"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Shiv Sena-Uddhav Balasaheb Thackeray / Bharatiya Janata Party / National Democratic Alliance.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. articles.title: Suspected Ukrainian sea drones hit Russian warship at Benghazi naval base, Libyan officials say
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The strike at the Benghazi Naval Base in eastern Libya severely damaged the Merkury, a Russian navy corvette, and ignited a fire at the facility, two Libyan military officials said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A suspected Ukrainian drone strike hit a Russian warship on Sunday (November 22, 2026) at a naval base in Libya, officials said, the latest attack in the North African nation linked to the Russia-Ukraine war. The strike at the Benghazi Naval Base in eastern Libya severely damaged the Merkury, a Russian navy corvette, and ignited a fire at the facility, two Libyan military officials said. They said that several Ukrainian sea drones were launched at the ship from a base run by Ukrainian forces in western Libya, according to an initial investigation into the attack. At least four drones were intercepted and destroyed, while two hit the warship, they said. The officials, affiliated with the self-styled Libyan National Army, which controls eastern and southern Libya, spoke on condition of anonymity because they weren't allowed to talk with reporters. Libya has been divided since a NATO-backed uprising toppled longtime dictator Muammar Gaddafi, who was later killed, in 2011. A UN-supported government is based in Tripoli, and a rival administration is located in the east. The oil-rich nation remains a focal point for a long-running rivalry between Russia and the West. The eastern Libya-based government said in a statement that the strike on Sunday (November 22) caused an explosion and fire at the base, which was later extinguished. The Almasar satellite television channel aired footage showing a vessel erupting into flames. It said the Libyan navy rescued the crew of the Maltese-flagged ship. A corvette is a warship smaller than a frigate or destroyer and is built to patrol coastal waters and escort other ships. The vessel had docked at the Libyan base for refuelling and supplies as part of a cooperation agreement between Russia and the eastern-based government in Libya, the statement said, without providing details on the vessel or its cargo. A joint investigation was launched with Russia to “uncover the circumstances of the attack, its source, and the party behind it,” the statement said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: No group immediately claimed responsibility for the attack. There was no immediate comment from either Russia or Ukraine.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #20 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Suspected Ukrainian sea drones hit Russian warship at Benghazi naval base, Libyan officials say

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 06:32:56 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The strike at the Benghazi Naval Base in eastern Libya severely damaged the Merkury, a Russian navy corvette, and ignited a fire at the facility, two Libyan military officials said

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A suspected Ukrainian drone strike hit a Russian warship on Sunday (November 22, 2026) at a naval base in Libya, officials said, the latest attack in the North African nation linked to the Russia-Ukraine war. The strike at the Benghazi Naval Base in eastern Libya severely damaged the Merkury, a Russian navy corvette, and ignited a fire at the facility, two Libyan military officials said. They said that several Ukrainian sea drones were launched at the ship from a base run by Ukrainian forces in western Libya, according to an initial investigation into the attack. At least four drones were intercepted and destroyed, while two hit the warship, they said. The officials, affiliated with the self-styled Libyan National Army, which controls eastern and southern Libya, spoke on condition of anonymity because they weren't allowed to talk with reporters. Libya has been divided since a NATO-backed uprising toppled longtime dictator Muammar Gaddafi, who was later killed, in 2011. A UN-supported government is based in Tripoli, and a rival administration is located in the east. The oil-rich nation remains a focal point for a long-running rivalry between Russia and the West. The eastern Libya-based government said in a statement that the strike on Sunday (November 22) caused an explosion and fire at the base, which was later extinguished. The Almasar satellite television channel aired footage showing a vessel erupting into flames. It said the Libyan navy rescued the crew of the Maltese-flagged ship. A corvette is a warship smaller than a frigate or destroyer and is built to patrol coastal waters and escort other ships. The vessel had docked at the Libyan base for refuelling and supplies as part of a cooperation agreement between Russia and the eastern-based government in Libya, the statement said, without providing details on the vessel or its cargo. A joint investigation was launched with Russia to “uncover the circumstances of the attack, its source, and the party behind it,” the statement said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: No group immediately claimed responsibility for the attack. There was no immediate comment from either Russia or Ukraine.

articles.title: Father, daughter detained by ICE at Seattle airport were travelling to family baptism, says lawyer
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Other passengers boarding the Alaska Airlines flight used their cellphones to film the father and daughter being detained by the officers, who were wearing unmarked jackets and khaki pants

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A father and daughter detained by masked immigration officers on an airport jet bridge in Seattle, causing chaos in front of other passengers, were heading to a family baptism ceremony in California, their lawyer said Sunday (November 22, 2026). Other passengers boarding the Alaska Airlines flight at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport on Saturday (November 21) used their cellphones to film the father and daughter being detained by the officers, who were wearing unmarked jackets and khaki pants. The recordings were widely viewed on social media. The videos show the officers struggling with someone on the ground. The flight, bound for Los Angeles, was delayed. Immigration and Customs Enforcement said in a statement that its officers detained Ricardo Larrondo Mendoza, an immigrant from Mexico who, it said, had overstayed his visa "in violation of our nation's laws.” During the confrontation, another passenger “hurled hot coffee on the officers,” the ICE statement said. That woman, Sofia Hernandez Mejia, was determined to be in the U.S. illegally from Mexico and to have also overstayed her visa, ICE said. She could be charged with assaulting a federal officer. The father and daughter were travelling to attend a baptism ceremony in California and are seeking asylum in the U.S., where they have lived since 2015, their lawyer, Olia Catala, told The Associated Press in a telephone interview on Sunday (November 22). They have no criminal record, Ms. Catala said. Ms. Mejia, in her mid-20s, had married a U.S. citizen and filed paperwork for adjustment of her status, the attorney said. Ms. Mejia's husband was accompanying Ms. Mejia and her father when they were detained Saturday (November 21), Ms. Catala added. The husband was not detained, the attorney said. “They've done everything correctly, and these are educated people," Ms. Catala said of the father and daughter. "She went to college, to university; she worked for a nonprofit. No criminal history [for] any of them. So it's just heartbreaking.” Both were being held at the Northwest ICE Processing Centre in Tacoma, Ms. Catala said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: She said Ms. Mejia was carrying a cup of coffee when the confrontation occurred.

articles.newspaperPrintHtml:
🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #21 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Father, daughter detained by ICE at Seattle airport were travelling to family baptism, says lawyer

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 05:37:05 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Other passengers boarding the Alaska Airlines flight used their cellphones to film the father and daughter being detained by the officers, who were wearing unmarked jackets and khaki pants

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A father and daughter detained by masked immigration officers on an airport jet bridge in Seattle, causing chaos in front of other passengers, were heading to a family baptism ceremony in California, their lawyer said Sunday (November 22, 2026). Other passengers boarding the Alaska Airlines flight at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport on Saturday (November 21) used their cellphones to film the father and daughter being detained by the officers, who were wearing unmarked jackets and khaki pants. The recordings were widely viewed on social media. The videos show the officers struggling with someone on the ground. The flight, bound for Los Angeles, was delayed. Immigration and Customs Enforcement said in a statement that its officers detained Ricardo Larrondo Mendoza, an immigrant from Mexico who, it said, had overstayed his visa "in violation of our nation's laws.” During the confrontation, another passenger “hurled hot coffee on the officers,” the ICE statement said. That woman, Sofia Hernandez Mejia, was determined to be in the U.S. illegally from Mexico and to have also overstayed her visa, ICE said. She could be charged with assaulting a federal officer. The father and daughter were travelling to attend a baptism ceremony in California and are seeking asylum in the U.S., where they have lived since 2015, their lawyer, Olia Catala, told The Associated Press in a telephone interview on Sunday (November 22). They have no criminal record, Ms. Catala said. Ms. Mejia, in her mid-20s, had married a U.S. citizen and filed paperwork for adjustment of her status, the attorney said. That woman, Sofia Hernandez Mejia, was determined to be in the U.S. illegally from Mexico and to have also overstayed her visa, ICE said. She could be charged with assaulting a federal officer. articles.title: Israel’s Eisenkot condemns arson attacks by Jewish settlers in West Bank
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Gadi Eisenkot called the attacks ‘Jewish terrorism’, saying that ‘extremist groups that set ⁠fire to vehicles and homes are undermining regional stability, putting lives at risk and doing grave damage to Israel’s national security and foreign relations’

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Israeli militant settlers attacked Palestinian villages in the occupied West Bank ‌early on Sunday (November 22, 2026), starting fires and scrawling racist graffiti, residents said, prompting an ​accusation of “Jewish terrorism” from the man trying to form an Israeli government. The attacks come nearly a month after an inconclusive election stripped incumbent Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of his ‌majority. Opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot has been asked to form a government, though his prospects seem little better. Reuters saw burned-out Palestinian vehicles and walls spray-painted with slogans ‌such as “Revenge” and “Death to Arabs” in villages near Ramallah. No one immediately claimed responsibility and ‌no ⁠injuries were reported. Mr. Eisenkot called the attacks “Jewish terrorism”, saying that “extremist groups that set ⁠fire to vehicles and homes are undermining regional stability, putting lives at risk and doing grave damage to Israel’s national security and foreign relations”. He said the policies of Itamar Ben-Gvir and Bezalel Smotrich, ultra-nationalist ministers in Mr. Netanyahu’s cabinet, had “brought the ​area to the brink of anarchy, ‌and the authorities have yet to address the crisis”. Mr. Netanyahu has not yet commented, but Foreign Minister Gideon Saar condemned the attacks by a “handful of extremists” and said they are “against our values and do not represent the law-abiding citizens of Judea and Samaria” — the biblical ‌names for the West Bank. “Israeli authorities are firmly committed to enforcing the law against extremist ​violence,” he told the ELNET Jerusalem Summit. UN bodies and most countries of the world deny the legality of the settlements, which make the ⁠prospect of an independent Palestinian state ever more remote, a position Israel disputes. Israeli police said they opened an investigation into the attacks, while the military condemned the violence, saying soldiers and police ‌had been dispatched to the areas of Deir as-Sudan, Deir Abu Masha’al, Kafr Malik and At-Tuwani “following reports and footage showing vehicles being set on fire and graffiti being sprayed in the area”.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Ben-Gvir replied in an X post that Mr. Eisenkot’s condemnation amounted to selling out to Arab parties, which could become part of a possible new government. Mr. Smotrich favours settlement expansion and wants Israel to annex the West Bank.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #22 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Israel’s Eisenkot condemns arson attacks by Jewish settlers in West Bank

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 03:32:28 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Gadi Eisenkot called the attacks ‘Jewish terrorism’, saying that ‘extremist groups that set ⁠fire to vehicles and homes are undermining regional stability, putting lives at risk and doing grave damage to Israel’s national security and foreign relations’

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Israeli militant settlers attacked Palestinian villages in the occupied West Bank ‌early on Sunday (November 22, 2026), starting fires and scrawling racist graffiti, residents said, prompting an ​accusation of “Jewish terrorism” from the man trying to form an Israeli government. The attacks come nearly a month after an inconclusive election stripped incumbent Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of his ‌majority. Opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot has been asked to form a government, though his prospects seem little better. Reuters saw burned-out Palestinian vehicles and walls spray-painted with slogans ‌such as “Revenge” and “Death to Arabs” in villages near Ramallah. No one immediately claimed responsibility and ‌no ⁠injuries were reported. Mr. Eisenkot called the attacks “Jewish terrorism”, saying that “extremist groups that set ⁠fire to vehicles and homes are undermining regional stability, putting lives at risk and doing grave damage to Israel’s national security and foreign relations”. He said the policies of Itamar Ben-Gvir and Bezalel Smotrich, ultra-nationalist ministers in Mr. Netanyahu’s cabinet, had “brought the ​area to the brink of anarchy, ‌and the authorities have yet to address the crisis”. Mr. Netanyahu has not yet commented, but Foreign Minister Gideon Saar condemned the attacks by a “handful of extremists” and said they are “against our values and do not represent the law-abiding citizens of Judea and Samaria” — the biblical ‌names for the West Bank. “Israeli authorities are firmly committed to enforcing the law against extremist ​violence,” he told the ELNET Jerusalem Summit. UN bodies and most countries of the world deny the legality of the settlements, which make the ⁠prospect of an independent Palestinian state ever more remote, a position Israel disputes. Israeli police said they opened an investigation into the attacks, while the military condemned the violence, saying soldiers and police ‌had been dispatched to the areas of Deir as-Sudan, Deir Abu Masha’al, Kafr Malik and At-Tuwani “following reports and footage showing vehicles being set on fire and graffiti being sprayed in the area”.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Ben-Gvir replied in an X post that Mr. Eisenkot’s condemnation amounted to selling out to Arab parties, which could become part of a possible new government. Mr. Smotrich favours settlement expansion and wants Israel to annex the West Bank.

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Investigation (Adjective / Verb)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Investigation' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Inconclusive (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Inconclusive' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🌐 International & Geopolitics passage on "Israel’s Eisenkot condemns arson attacks by Jewish settlers in West Bank", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Gadi Eisenkot called the attacks ‘Jewish terrorism’, saying that ‘extremist groups that set ⁠fire to vehicles and homes are undermining regional...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Israel’s Eisenkot condemns arson attacks by Jewi' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Israel’s Eisenkot condemns arson attacks by J' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Israel’s Eisenkot condemns arson attacks by J' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Gadi Eisenkot called the attacks ‘Jewish terrorism’, saying that ‘extremist groups that set ⁠fire to vehicles and homes are undermining regional..." (Hinglish Arth: गादी ईसेनकोट ने हमलों को 'यहूदी आतंकवाद' कहा, उन्होंने कहा कि 'वाहनों और घरों में आग लगाने वाले चरमपंथी समूह क्षेत्रीय स्थिरता को कमजोर कर रहे हैं, जीवन को खतरे में डाल रहे हैं और इजरायल के राष्ट्र को गंभीर नुकसान पहुंचा रहे हैं।')
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Israel’s Eisenkot condemns arson attacks by Jewish settlers in West Bank"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Smotrich favours settlement expansion and wants Israel to annex the West Bank.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Smotrich favours settlement expansion and wants Israel to annex the West Bank." articles.title: Central California concert shooting: Nine people shot; one in critical condition
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Authorities said that they believe the shooting ‘may be gang-related’ but didn’t elaborate

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Nine people were shot at a concert in central California, leaving one person critically injured with a chest injury, the local sheriff said Sunday (November 22). The shooting broke out around 7:30 p.m. Saturday (November 21) at a concert attended by about 150 people in Strathmore, a small town in Tulare County, a mountainous region in the centre of the state, the county sheriff's department said in a statement. An unspecified number of suspects opened fire on the crowd. No arrests were announced. One 26-year-old man was shot in the chest and required surgery. He remained in critical condition, the sheriff's department said. Two other victims, ages 19 and 22, also required surgery, while six people sustained minor injuries. Authorities said that they believe the shooting “may be gang-related” but didn't elaborate. The show in the town of roughly 3,000 people featured performers from neighbouring states, the department said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The department didn't immediately respond to emailed questions seeking further details but said there was no longer any immediate threat to the public.

1. Core Context & Background: Authorities said that they believe the shooting ‘may be gang-related’ but didn’t elaborate

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Nine people were shot at a concert in central California, leaving one person critically injured with a chest injury, the local sheriff said Sunday (November 22). The shooting broke out around 7:30 p.m. Saturday (November 21) at a concert attended by about 150 people in Strathmore, a small town in Tulare County, a mountainous region in the centre of the state, the county sheriff's department said in a statement. An unspecified number of suspects opened fire on the crowd. No arrests were announced. One 26-year-old man was shot in the chest and required surgery. He remained in critical condition, the sheriff's department said. Two other victims, ages 19 and 22, also required surgery, while six people sustained minor injuries. Authorities said that they believe the shooting “may be gang-related” but didn't elaborate. The show in the town of roughly 3,000 people featured performers from neighbouring states, the department said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The department didn't immediately respond to emailed questions seeking further details but said there was no longer any immediate threat to the public.

articles.title: Scientists report strong new evidence that specially bred mosquitoes can fend off dengue
articles.examRelevance: Prelims & GS-III: ISRO/DRDO Missions, Quantum & High-Tech, Biodiversity, Ramsar Sites & Climate Action
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The latest research comes as Florida grapples with an unusually large outbreak of the virus, what appears to be the biggest in any U.S. state since at least the 1940s

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Children who lived in Brazilian neighbourhoods buzzing with a special kind of mosquito were far less likely to catch dengue or another worrisome virus, chikungunya, researchers reported Saturday. The major study of more than 5,700 children in one of the world's dengue hot spots offers new evidence that breeding mosquitoes unable to transmit these viruses can be a viable strategy rather than solely relying on pesticides and trying to avoid getting bitten. In neighbourhoods populated by these so-called Wolbachia-carrying mosquitoes, researchers found about a 69% reduction in dengue and chikungunya infections in schoolchildren compared to similar neighbourhoods — an effect sustained even during Brazil's severe 2024 dengue outbreak, said Dr. Sri Edupuganti of Emory University, part of the international research team. The researchers reported the findings at a meeting of the American Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene. “This is really exciting,” said David Hamer, a global health expert at Boston University who wasn't involved with the Brazilian study. He predicts that pairing more use of these Wolbachia mosquitoes with existing steps to fight mosquito-borne disease could “knock dengue down to much lower levels” in many places. The latest research comes as Florida grapples with an unusually large outbreak of the virus, what appears to be the biggest in any U.S. state since at least the 1940s. Usually in the continental US, dengue is found mostly in people who travelled internationally. But as of Friday, Florida health officials had tallied more than 650 locally acquired cases, about three-quarters of them in Hillsborough County, home to Tampa. Outside the U.S., the nonprofit World Mosquito Program has pioneered the Wolbachia strategy. How it works: Scientists breed mosquitoes to carry a kind of bacteria called Wolbachia. It is harmless to people and common in many insects, although not dengue-carrying Aedes aegypti mosquitoes. The bacteria dramatically reduce the mosquitoes' ability to transmit certain viruses. Female mosquitoes spread the bacteria to their offspring, so releasing enough of the specially bred insects — males and females — into an area allows Wolbachia to gradually become established in the local mosquito population.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Field trials and other studies in Indonesia and elsewhere have shown the strategy can significantly lower dengue diagnoses. But because people with mild symptoms may not be diagnosed, the new study in Belo Horizonte, Brazil, went further. Researchers tested blood for signs of dengue, chikungunya or the Zika virus.

🚀 Science, Tech & Environment Paragraph #25 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Scientists report strong new evidence that specially bred mosquitoes can fend off dengue

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 05:58:17 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The latest research comes as Florida grapples with an unusually large outbreak of the virus, what appears to be the biggest in any U.S. state since at least the 1940s

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Children who lived in Brazilian neighbourhoods buzzing with a special kind of mosquito were far less likely to catch dengue or another worrisome virus, chikungunya, researchers reported Saturday. The major study of more than 5,700 children in one of the world's dengue hot spots offers new evidence that breeding mosquitoes unable to transmit these viruses can be a viable strategy rather than solely relying on pesticides and trying to avoid getting bitten. In neighbourhoods populated by these so-called Wolbachia-carrying mosquitoes, researchers found about a 69% reduction in dengue and chikungunya infections in schoolchildren compared to similar neighbourhoods — an effect sustained even during Brazil's severe 2024 dengue outbreak, said Dr. Sri Edupuganti of Emory University, part of the international research team. The researchers reported the findings at a meeting of the American Society of Tropical Medicine and Hygiene. “This is really exciting,” said David Hamer, a global health expert at Boston University who wasn't involved with the Brazilian study. He predicts that pairing more use of these Wolbachia mosquitoes with existing steps to fight mosquito-borne disease could “knock dengue down to much lower levels” in many places. The latest research comes as Florida grapples with an unusually large outbreak of the virus, what appears to be the biggest in any U.S. state since at least the 1940s. Usually in the continental US, dengue is found mostly in people who travelled internationally. But as of Friday, Florida health officials had tallied more than 650 locally acquired cases, about three-quarters of them in Hillsborough County, home to Tampa. Outside the U.S., the nonprofit World Mosquito Program has pioneered the Wolbachia strategy. How it works: Scientists breed mosquitoes to carry a kind of bacteria called Wolbachia. It is harmless to people and common in many insects, although not dengue-carrying Aedes aegypti mosquitoes. The bacteria dramatically reduce the mosquitoes' ability to transmit certain viruses. Female mosquitoes spread the bacteria to their offspring, so releasing enough of the specially bred insects — males and females — into an area allows Wolbachia to gradually become established in the local mosquito population.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Field trials and other studies in Indonesia and elsewhere have shown the strategy can significantly lower dengue diagnoses. But because people with mild symptoms may not be diagnosed, the new study in Belo Horizonte, Brazil, went further. Researchers tested blood for signs of dengue, chikungunya or the Zika virus.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Predictably (Adverb)
जैसा पहले से अनुमान था — बिना किसी आश्चर्य के बिल्कुल पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक होना।
✓ Syn: Foreseeably, Expectedly, Inevitably  |  ✖ Ant: Unexpectedly, Surprisingly, Abruptly
Sustainability (Noun)
सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास।
✓ Syn: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability  |  ✖ Ant: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction
International (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'International' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Continental (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Continental' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🚀 Science, Tech & Environment passage on "Scientists report strong new evidence that specially bred mosquitoes can fend off dengue", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The latest research comes as Florida grapples with an unusually large outbreak of the virus, what appears to be the biggest in any U.S.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Scientists report strong new evidence that speci' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Scientists report strong new evidence that sp' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Scientists report strong new evidence that sp' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The latest research comes as Florida grapples with an unusually large outbreak of the virus, what appears to be the biggest in any U.S." (Hinglish Arth: नवीनतम शोध तब आया है जब फ्लोरिडा असामान्य रूप से बड़े पैमाने पर वायरस के प्रकोप से जूझ रहा है, जो किसी भी यू.एस. में सबसे बड़ा प्रतीत होता है।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Scientists report strong new evidence that specially bred mosquitoes can fend off dengue"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Researchers tested blood for signs of dengue, chikungunya or the Zika virus.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Researchers tested blood for signs of dengue, chikungunya or the Zika virus." (Hinglish Arth: शोधकर्ताओं ने डेंगू, चिकनगुनिया या जीका वायरस के लक्षणों के लिए रक्त का परीक्षण किया।)

He predicts that pairing more use of these Wolbachia mosquitoes with existing steps to fight mosquito-borne disease could “knock dengue down to much lower levels” in many places. The latest research comes as Florida grapples with an unusually large outbreak of the virus, what appears to be the biggest in any U.S. state since at least the 1940s. Usually in the continental US, dengue is found mostly in people who travelled internationally. But as of Friday, Florida health officials had tallied more than 650 locally acquired cases, about three-quarters of them in Hillsborough County, home to Tampa. Outside the U.S., the nonprofit World Mosquito Program has pioneered the Wolbachia strategy. How it works: Scientists breed mosquitoes to carry a kind of bacteria called Wolbachia. It is harmless to people and common in many insects, although not dengue-carrying Aedes aegypti mosquitoes. The bacteria dramatically reduce the mosquitoes' ability to transmit certain viruses. Female mosquitoes spread the bacteria to their offspring, so releasing enough of the specially bred insects — males and females — into an area allows Wolbachia to gradually become established in the local mosquito population.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Field trials and other studies in Indonesia and elsewhere have shown the strategy can significantly lower dengue diagnoses. But because people with mild symptoms may not be diagnosed, the new study in Belo Horizonte, Brazil, went further. Researchers tested blood for signs of dengue, chikungunya or the Zika virus.

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Minister says that midday meal workers need not worry about their jobs

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Minister for School Education and Literacy Madhu Bangarappa has assured that cluster kitchens (centralised cooking facilities) will not be established under the scheme providing midday meals to schoolchildren (Classes I to X) in the State. He said that midday meal workers need not worry about their jobs. On Monday, S. Balan, honorary president of Akshara Dasoha (Midday Meal Workers’ Union), met the Minister at his residence and submitted a list of demands, including not entertaining the idea of cluster kitchens. The delegation also sought a hike in monthly remuneration, citing the example of Keralam, where workers are paid ₹12,000, compared with ₹4,600 to ₹4,700 in Karnataka. Mr. Balan also raised concerns over substandard grains and rice being supplied to government schools to cook midday meals for children. The Minister sought precise details on where such incidents were occurring, promising strict action.

• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Minister for School Education and Literacy Madhu Bangarappa has assured that cluster kitchens (centralised cooking facilities) will not be established under the scheme providing midday meals to schoolchildren (Classes I to X) in the State. He said that midday meal workers need not worry about their jobs. On Monday, S. Balan, honorary president of Akshara Dasoha (Midday Meal Workers’ Union), met the Minister at his residence and submitted a list of demands, including not entertaining the idea of cluster kitchens. The delegation also sought a hike in monthly remuneration, citing the example of Keralam, where workers are paid ₹12,000, compared with ₹4,600 to ₹4,700 in Karnataka. Mr. Bangarappa said he would discuss the demand with the Chief Minister. “It is to our government’s credit that we previously raised the retirement corpus for midday meal workers to ₹40,000,” he said. He advised the union to meet Union government officials, noting that the midday meal scheme is not solely funded by the State government and involves participation from the Centre as well. Mr. Balan also raised concerns over substandard grains and rice being supplied to government schools to cook midday meals for children. The Minister sought precise details on where such incidents were occurring, promising strict action.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The delegation submitted a memorandum to the Minister outlining various demands, including the establishment of joint bank accounts for school headmasters and head cooks, a retirement corpus of at least ₹1 lakh, and a monthly pension of ₹5,000.

articles.title: Voters’ personal data submitted though Form 6 was exposed on ECI citizen service portal, claims report
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: While records going back to 2023 were verified for the report, there was nothing to suggest earlier records were protected, so the exposure may be longer

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: For at least three years, the personal data that voters submitted to the Election Commission of India through Form 6, the application for registration as an elector, was exposed on its Citizen Service Portal (https://voters.eci.gov.in/ ) to anyone with a login, claims a report by ‘Charchagram’, a civic-tech initiative for building tools for enhancing transparency and accountability in public systems of India. It said that while records going back to 2023 were verified for this report, there was nothing to suggest earlier records were protected, so the exposure may be longer. According to the report, using ECI published data, it estimates that at least seven crore Form 6 enrolments took place in this period. Each Form 6 application holds a citizen’s name, their relative’s name, gender, phone number, email, home address, photograph, Aadhaar details, age-proof documents, and address-proof documents, among other details. “We audited the front-end code available in public. And while auditing, [we] found that there is URL through which anyone can access Form 6 data of other voters,” said Saurav Rajput, a data scientist at Charchagram. Opening “voters.eci.gov.in/form6?refId= ” returned a web-page showing all the applicants’ details to any logged-in user, regardless of who the applicant was. “The reference IDs follow a predictable state, constituency, type and date/sequence pattern. The server did not check that the application belonged to the person asking. The predictability of the reference ID amplifies this security issue, since any user can scrape the data one by one in large volumes,” according to the report. Following the revelation, Charchagram says it reported the matter privately to the ECI and to CERT-In. CERT-In is the national nodal agency for responding to computer security incidents as and when they occur.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “We asked for a fix within seven days and for written acknowledgement and confirmation when it was done,” Mr. Rajput said.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #8 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Voters’ personal data submitted though Form 6 was exposed on ECI citizen service portal, claims report

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 07:24:11 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: While records going back to 2023 were verified for the report, there was nothing to suggest earlier records were protected, so the exposure may be longer

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: For at least three years, the personal data that voters submitted to the Election Commission of India through Form 6, the application for registration as an elector, was exposed on its Citizen Service Portal (https://voters.eci.gov.in/ ) to anyone with a login, claims a report by ‘Charchagram’, a civic-tech initiative for building tools for enhancing transparency and accountability in public systems of India. It said that while records going back to 2023 were verified for this report, there was nothing to suggest earlier records were protected, so the exposure may be longer. According to the report, using ECI published data, it estimates that at least seven crore Form 6 enrolments took place in this period. Each Form 6 application holds a citizen’s name, their relative’s name, gender, phone number, email, home address, photograph, Aadhaar details, age-proof documents, and address-proof documents, among other details. “We audited the front-end code available in public. And while auditing, [we] found that there is URL through which anyone can access Form 6 data of other voters,” said Saurav Rajput, a data scientist at Charchagram. Opening “voters.eci.gov.in/form6?refId= ” returned a web-page showing all the applicants’ details to any logged-in user, regardless of who the applicant was. “The reference IDs follow a predictable state, constituency, type and date/sequence pattern. The server did not check that the application belonged to the person asking. The predictability of the reference ID amplifies this security issue, since any user can scrape the data one by one in large volumes,” according to the report. Following the revelation, Charchagram says it reported the matter privately to the ECI and to CERT-In. CERT-In is the national nodal agency for responding to computer security incidents as and when they occur.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “We asked for a fix within seven days and for written acknowledgement and confirmation when it was done,” Mr. Rajput said.

Predictably (Adverb)
जैसा पहले से अनुमान था — बिना किसी आश्चर्य के बिल्कुल पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक होना।
✓ Syn: Foreseeably, Expectedly, Inevitably  |  ✖ Ant: Unexpectedly, Surprisingly, Abruptly
Constitutional (Adjective)
संवैधानिक — देश के संविधान (Constitution) के दायरे और मौलिक अधिकारों के अनुरूप।
✓ Syn: Statutory, Legitimate, Lawful  |  ✖ Ant: Unconstitutional, Illegal, Arbitrary
Accountability (Noun)
जवाबदेही — अपने फैसलों और काम का जनता तथा संविधान को हिसाब देने की बाध्यता।
✓ Syn: Responsibility, Answerability, Liability  |  ✖ Ant: Immunity, Exemption, Irresponsibility
Acknowledgement (Adjective)
पावती — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Acknowledgement' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Voters’ personal data submitted though Form 6 was exposed on ECI citizen service portal, claims report", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. While records going back to 2023 were verified for the report, there was nothing to suggest earlier records were protected, so the exposure may be...
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Voters’ personal data submitted though Form 6 wa' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Voters’ personal data submitted though Form 6' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Voters’ personal data submitted though Form 6' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "While records going back to 2023 were verified for the report, there was nothing to suggest earlier records were protected, so the exposure may be..." (Hinglish Arth: हालाँकि रिपोर्ट के लिए 2023 से पहले के रिकॉर्ड सत्यापित किए गए थे, लेकिन ऐसा कुछ भी नहीं था जो बताता हो कि पहले के रिकॉर्ड सुरक्षित थे, इसलिए एक्सपोज़र लंबा हो सकता है)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Voters’ personal data submitted though Form 6 was exposed on ECI citizen service portal, claims report"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. “We asked for a fix within seven days and for written acknowledgement and confirmation when it was done,” Mr.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "“We asked for a fix within seven days and for written acknowledgement and confirmation when it was done,” Mr." (Hinglish Arth: श्रीमान ने कहा, "हमने सात दिनों के भीतर समाधान करने और ऐसा हो जाने पर लिखित पावती और पुष्टि के लिए कहा।")

articles.title: A.P. CM calls for wider use of AI in healthcare, agriculture to improve public services
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Chandrababu Naidu directs senior officials to take up capacity-building programmes to enhance the technological capabilities and professional skills of government employees

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu has called for the wider application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) across various sectors, including healthcare and agriculture, to improve service delivery, administrative efficiency and government revenue. Reviewing the functioning of the Real Time Governance Society (RTGS) with senior officials of various departments on Sunday, Mr. Naidu stressed the need to leverage modern technology and the AI stack to simplify government services and improve the performance of departments. He directed officials to take measures to ensure that public services were delivered more efficiently and promptly. He also called for capacity-building programmes to enhance the technological capabilities and professional skills of government employees. Stressing that delays in addressing public grievances should be avoided, the Chief Minister has directed officials to expedite the resolution of complaints received through the Public Grievance Redressal System. A positive public perception of government services was essential for improving governance and called upon departments to regularly review their performance and address shortcomings in monitoring mechanisms, he said. Mr. Naidu said the government was using Revenue and Legal AI stacks to analyse various issues and identify ways to improve departmental performance. Data-driven decision-making would become increasingly important in governance in the coming years, he observed. Referring to the recent local body elections, he said the results could serve as one of the indicators of the government’s performance. He asked senior departmental officials to strengthen monitoring mechanisms and ensure better delivery of services to the public.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Senior officials from the Social Welfare, BC Welfare, Minority Welfare, Finance, Municipal Administration and Energy departments, besides RTGS officials, participated in the review meeting.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #9 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 A.P. CM calls for wider use of AI in healthcare, agriculture to improve public services

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 07:22:42 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Chandrababu Naidu directs senior officials to take up capacity-building programmes to enhance the technological capabilities and professional skills of government employees

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu has called for the wider application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) across various sectors, including healthcare and agriculture, to improve service delivery, administrative efficiency and government revenue. Reviewing the functioning of the Real Time Governance Society (RTGS) with senior officials of various departments on Sunday, Mr. Naidu stressed the need to leverage modern technology and the AI stack to simplify government services and improve the performance of departments. He directed officials to take measures to ensure that public services were delivered more efficiently and promptly. He also called for capacity-building programmes to enhance the technological capabilities and professional skills of government employees. Stressing that delays in addressing public grievances should be avoided, the Chief Minister has directed officials to expedite the resolution of complaints received through the Public Grievance Redressal System. A positive public perception of government services was essential for improving governance and called upon departments to regularly review their performance and address shortcomings in monitoring mechanisms, he said. Mr. Naidu said the government was using Revenue and Legal AI stacks to analyse various issues and identify ways to improve departmental performance. Data-driven decision-making would become increasingly important in governance in the coming years, he observed. Referring to the recent local body elections, he said the results could serve as one of the indicators of the government’s performance. He asked senior departmental officials to strengthen monitoring mechanisms and ensure better delivery of services to the public.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Senior officials from the Social Welfare, BC Welfare, Minority Welfare, Finance, Municipal Administration and Energy departments, besides RTGS officials, participated in the review meeting.

✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "A.P. CM calls for wider use of AI in healthcare, agriculture to improve public services", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Chandrababu Naidu directs senior officials to take up capacity-building programmes to enhance the technological capabilities and professional skills...

D. The author contends that 'A.P. CM calls for wider use of AI in healthca' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. articles.title: Government will explore all possible ways to avoid electricity restriction in Keralam, says Minister
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Sunny Joseph announces that the Idukki and Cheruthoni dams will be opened to tourists starting December 1

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The government will explore all possible ways to avoid power restrictions in the State, Electricity Minister Sunny Joseph has said. Addressing a Kerala State Electricity Board (KSEB) review meeting at Thodupuzha in Idukki on Monday, Joseph said that due to the El Niño effect, rainfall has been largely reduced in the State, affecting the storage levels of hydroelectric dams. “Compared to the previous year, the water level in Idukki, including major hydel dams, is more than 20% below storage this year. Presently, there is only 60% storage in the hydel dams in the State,” the Minister said. Mr. Joseph further noted that the government will t launch initiatives to arrange power from other sources. According to KSEB data, the water level in the Idukki dam on Monday was 2,368.9 feet (63%), compared with 2,384.98 feet (79%) on the same day last year. During the meeting, the Minister announced that the Idukki and Cheruthoni dams will be opened to tourists starting December 1. He said the decision was taken based on repeated demands from various quarters. The Minister also directed officials to take steps to resume the boating facility at the Anayirankal dam reservoir. Based on the recommendation of a panel appointed by the High Court to address human-animal conflicts in Chinnakkanal, the boating facility in Anayirankal was suspended following the court’s direction on July 14, 2023. The panel had argued that stopping the boating facility in Anayirankal would help prevent human-elephant conflicts in the Anayirankal and Chinnakkanal regions.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Joseph further noted that to tap the tourism potential in Idukki, the KSEB and the Tourism department will jointly implement projects in the district. He also said the Electricity department will seek permission from the forest department to set up an overhead power line to Edamalakkudy, the State’s first tribal panchayat, to provide electricity to the tribal community.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Government will explore all possible ways to avoid electricity restriction in Keralam, says Minister

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 07:19:11 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Sunny Joseph announces that the Idukki and Cheruthoni dams will be opened to tourists starting December 1

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The government will explore all possible ways to avoid power restrictions in the State, Electricity Minister Sunny Joseph has said. Addressing a Kerala State Electricity Board (KSEB) review meeting at Thodupuzha in Idukki on Monday, Joseph said that due to the El Niño effect, rainfall has been largely reduced in the State, affecting the storage levels of hydroelectric dams. “Compared to the previous year, the water level in Idukki, including major hydel dams, is more than 20% below storage this year. Presently, there is only 60% storage in the hydel dams in the State,” the Minister said. Mr. Joseph further noted that the government will t launch initiatives to arrange power from other sources. According to KSEB data, the water level in the Idukki dam on Monday was 2,368.9 feet (63%), compared with 2,384.98 feet (79%) on the same day last year. During the meeting, the Minister announced that the Idukki and Cheruthoni dams will be opened to tourists starting December 1. He said the decision was taken based on repeated demands from various quarters. The Minister also directed officials to take steps to resume the boating facility at the Anayirankal dam reservoir. Based on the recommendation of a panel appointed by the High Court to address human-animal conflicts in Chinnakkanal, the boating facility in Anayirankal was suspended following the court’s direction on July 14, 2023. The panel had argued that stopping the boating facility in Anayirankal would help prevent human-elephant conflicts in the Anayirankal and Chinnakkanal regions.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Joseph further noted that to tap the tourism potential in Idukki, the KSEB and the Tourism department will jointly implement projects in the district. He also said the Electricity department will seek permission from the forest department to set up an overhead power line to Edamalakkudy, the State’s first tribal panchayat, to provide electricity to the tribal community.

कानूनी अनुमति या स्वीकार्यता — किसी कार्य को करने की वैध छूट।

क्रियान्वयन / ज़मीनी स्तर पर लागू करना — किसी योजना या फैसले को असलियत में पूरा करना।
✓ Syn: Execution, Enforcement, Fulfillment  |  ✖ Ant: Abandonment, Neglect, Cancellation
Recommendation (Noun)
सिफारिश — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Recommendation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Hydroelectric (Adjective)
पनबिजली — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Hydroelectric' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Sunny Joseph announces that the Idukki and Cheruthoni dams will be opened to tourists starting December 1." B. He also said the Electricity department will seek permission from the forest department to set up an overhead power line to Edamalakkudy, the State’s...

articles.title: Shivamogga airport included in UDAN 6.0 tender process, says MP
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: B.Y. Raghavendra, Shivamogga MP, said that the Union government has decided to include Shivamogga airport in the revised UDAN 6.0 tender process. He expressed hope that the airport would become active again, with several flights operating from there.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Speaking to presspersons in Shivamogga on Monday, Mr. Raghavendra said uncertainty over the airport’s inclusion had persisted for the past 15 to 20 days, and that it now appeared to be clearing. The last date for bids is December 31. He said that under the earlier version of the scheme, an airport would have a one-year commercial break after three years of Viability Gap Funding (VGF) support for flight operations. This time, following requests from people’s representatives, including himself, the Centre has included the airport in the next tender without any such break. He said this would allow Shivamogga to grow commercially under UDAN over the next five years, and that flight services would follow naturally. Unlike earlier tenders, the current one does not name specific routes. Airlines have the freedom to choose which routes to operate from Shivamogga, and bidders would be eligible for UDAN subsidy. Mr. Raghavendra said efforts were under way to hold talks with three airlines about their participation in the tender. He thanked the Prime Minister, former Chief Minister B.S. Yediyurappa and Union Minister Pralhad Joshi for their support. Mr. Raghavendra said the tender process could take until February or March 2027 to be finalised and for operations to begin, which could leave a gap of three to four months. He urged the State government to provide temporary VGF support for two to three months in the interim, at least for the Shivamogga–Bengaluru and Shivamogga–Hyderabad routes, or one of them. If an airline chose these routes under the tender, he said, the State could withdraw its support. Regarding cargo services and night landing, he said decisions would be taken after a survey based on local demand, crops and export opportunities was conducted.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Flight operations under UDAN from Shivamogga airport ended last week. As a result, the airport built at Sogane, near Shivamogga, has gone silent. It was inaugurated in February 2023 and has been operating since August 2023.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 Shivamogga airport included in UDAN 6.0 tender process, says MP

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 07:19:10 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: B.Y. Raghavendra, Shivamogga MP, said that the Union government has decided to include Shivamogga airport in the revised UDAN 6.0 tender process. He expressed hope that the airport would become active again, with several flights operating from there.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Speaking to presspersons in Shivamogga on Monday, Mr. Raghavendra said uncertainty over the airport’s inclusion had persisted for the past 15 to 20 days, and that it now appeared to be clearing. The last date for bids is December 31. He said that under the earlier version of the scheme, an airport would have a one-year commercial break after three years of Viability Gap Funding (VGF) support for flight operations. This time, following requests from people’s representatives, including himself, the Centre has included the airport in the next tender without any such break. He said this would allow Shivamogga to grow commercially under UDAN over the next five years, and that flight services would follow naturally. Unlike earlier tenders, the current one does not name specific routes. Airlines have the freedom to choose which routes to operate from Shivamogga, and bidders would be eligible for UDAN subsidy. Mr. Raghavendra said efforts were under way to hold talks with three airlines about their participation in the tender. He thanked the Prime Minister, former Chief Minister B.S. Yediyurappa and Union Minister Pralhad Joshi for their support. Mr. Raghavendra said the tender process could take until February or March 2027 to be finalised and for operations to begin, which could leave a gap of three to four months. He urged the State government to provide temporary VGF support for two to three months in the interim, at least for the Shivamogga–Bengaluru and Shivamogga–Hyderabad routes, or one of them. If an airline chose these routes under the tender, he said, the State could withdraw its support. Regarding cargo services and night landing, he said decisions would be taken after a survey based on local demand, crops and export opportunities was conducted.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Flight operations under UDAN from Shivamogga airport ended last week. As a result, the airport built at Sogane, near Shivamogga, has gone silent. It was inaugurated in February 2023 and has been operating since August 2023.

A. Raghavendra, Shivamogga MP, said that the Union government has decided to include Shivamogga airport in the revised UDAN 6.0 tender process.

articles.summary: 1. Core Context & Background: B.Y. Raghavendra, Shivamogga MP, said that the Union government has decided to include Shivamogga airport in the revised UDAN 6.0 tender process. He expressed hope that the airport would become active again, with several flights operating from there.
articles.keyPoints:
• 1. Core Context & Background: B.Y. Raghavendra, Shivamogga MP, said that the Union government has decided to include Shivamogga airport in the revised UDAN 6.0 tender process. He expressed hope that the airport would become active again, with several flights operating from there.
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Speaking to presspersons in Shivamogga on Monday, Mr. Raghavendra said uncertainty over the airport’s inclusion had persisted for the past 15 to 20 days, and that it now appeared to be clearing. The last date for bids is December 31. He said that under the earlier version of the scheme, an airport would have a one-year commercial break after three years of Viability Gap Funding (VGF) support for flight operations. This time, following requests from people’s representatives, including himself, the Centre has included the airport in the next tender without any such break. He said this would allow Shivamogga to grow commercially under UDAN over the next five years, and that flight services would follow naturally. Unlike earlier tenders, the current one does not name specific routes. Airlines have the freedom to choose which routes to operate from Shivamogga, and bidders would be eligible for UDAN subsidy. Mr. Raghavendra said efforts were under way to hold talks with three airlines about their participation in the tender. He thanked the Prime Minister, former Chief Minister B.S. Yediyurappa and Union Minister Pralhad Joshi for their support. Mr. Raghavendra said the tender process could take until February or March 2027 to be finalised and for operations to begin, which could leave a gap of three to four months. He urged the State government to provide temporary VGF support for two to three months in the interim, at least for the Shivamogga–Bengaluru and Shivamogga–Hyderabad routes, or one of them. If an airline chose these routes under the tender, he said, the State could withdraw its support. Regarding cargo services and night landing, he said decisions would be taken after a survey based on local demand, crops and export opportunities was conducted.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Flight operations under UDAN from Shivamogga airport ended last week. As a result, the airport built at Sogane, near Shivamogga, has gone silent. It was inaugurated in February 2023 and has been operating since August 2023.

articles.title: 3-member panel meet of KRMB ends without taking any decision on water use
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Telangana strongly opposed to AP’s demand for release of Nagarjunsagar water for use in Krishna Delta System

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The three-member committee of the Krishna River Management Board (KRMB) which met here on Monday to discuss the drinking water needs of the two member States — Andhra Pradesh and Telangana — for the next three months ended without taking any decision as Telangana strongly opposed A.P.’s indent of 19 tmc ft water, including 10 tmc ft for Krishna Delta System from Nagarjunasagar dam. The meeting chaired by Member-Secretary of the river board Satish Kumar Kamboj was attended by Engineers-in-Chief of Telangana and Andhra Pradesh O.V. Ramesh Babu and K. Narasimha Murthy. The meeting prolonged from forenoon to evening but no decision was taken as there was no consensus on utilisation of water available in Nagarjunsagar reservoir. In addition to the water indent placed by A.P. before the meeting for release of 9 tmc ft water from NS Right Canal, they also sought another 10 tmc ft water release from the reservoir for meeting the needs in the Krishna Delta System (KDS). On the other hand, Telangana asked for 21 tmc ft till February-end for drinking water needs of Hyderabad and other areas served by Nagarjunsagar. Telangana ENC strongly opposed the indent for 10 tmc ft water requirement for KDS stating that they would not allow even a drop of water to the system as water requirements of KDS were not linked to Nagarjunsagar reservoir releases. Speaking after the meeting, Mr. Ramesh Babu said even the 9 tmc ft water sought from the Right Canal was also not justifiable as A.P. has enough water stored in Pulichintala reservoir. He explained that Nagarjunsagar reservoir has only 45.4 tmc ft water above the minimum draw down level (MDDL) and of it 15 tmc ft is required for drinking needs of Hyderabad alone and the remaining 25 tmc ft was not sufficient to meet water unused so far by Telangana this water year. Further, he stated that Pulichintala has 26.75 tmc ft and Prakasam Barrage has another 2.44 tmc ft water available and water from Polavaram is also being drawn for the needs in the Krishna Basin through Pattiseema. There was no justification in A.P.’s demand for 19 tmc ft water as it had received good spells of rain due to the three recent cyclones, the Telangana ENC said. He stated that they asked for a full board meeting at the earliest to discuss all issues.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: As A.P. too stood ground with its demand suggesting that water could be drawn up to 490 ft level of Nagarjunsagar (534.4 ft level as at 6 pm on Monday), the three-member committee could not take any decision as Telangana insisted that water available in Nagarjunsagar below its MDDL was only for emergency needs.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (23 NOV)

📰 3-member panel meet of KRMB ends without taking any decision on water use

📌 Published: 23 Nov 2026, 07:16:09 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Telangana strongly opposed to AP’s demand for release of Nagarjunsagar water for use in Krishna Delta System

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The three-member committee of the Krishna River Management Board (KRMB) which met here on Monday to discuss the drinking water needs of the two member States — Andhra Pradesh and Telangana — for the next three months ended without taking any decision as Telangana strongly opposed A.P.’s indent of 19 tmc ft water, including 10 tmc ft for Krishna Delta System from Nagarjunasagar dam. The meeting chaired by Member-Secretary of the river board Satish Kumar Kamboj was attended by Engineers-in-Chief of Telangana and Andhra Pradesh O.V. Ramesh Babu and K. Narasimha Murthy. The meeting prolonged from forenoon to evening but no decision was taken as there was no consensus on utilisation of water available in Nagarjunsagar reservoir. In addition to the water indent placed by A.P. before the meeting for release of 9 tmc ft water from NS Right Canal, they also sought another 10 tmc ft water release from the reservoir for meeting the needs in the Krishna Delta System (KDS). On the other hand, Telangana asked for 21 tmc ft till February-end for drinking water needs of Hyderabad and other areas served by Nagarjunsagar. Telangana ENC strongly opposed the indent for 10 tmc ft water requirement for KDS stating that they would not allow even a drop of water to the system as water requirements of KDS were not linked to Nagarjunsagar reservoir releases. Speaking after the meeting, Mr. Ramesh Babu said even the 9 tmc ft water sought from the Right Canal was also not justifiable as A.P. has enough water stored in Pulichintala reservoir. He explained that Nagarjunsagar reservoir has only 45.4 tmc ft water above the minimum draw down level (MDDL) and of it 15 tmc ft is required for drinking needs of Hyderabad alone and the remaining 25 tmc ft was not sufficient to meet water unused so far by Telangana this water year. Further, he stated that Pulichintala has 26.75 tmc ft and Prakasam Barrage has another 2.44 tmc ft water available and water from Polavaram is also being drawn for the needs in the Krishna Basin through Pattiseema. There was no justification in A.P.’s demand for 19 tmc ft water as it had received good spells of rain due to the three recent cyclones, the Telangana ENC said. He stated that they asked for a full board meeting at the earliest to discuss all issues.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: As A.P. too stood ground with its demand suggesting that water could be drawn up to 490 ft level of Nagarjunsagar (534.4 ft level as at 6 pm on Monday), the three-member committee could not take any decision as Telangana insisted that water available in Nagarjunsagar below its MDDL was only for emergency needs.

articles.title: SBI, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank retain D-SIB status; RBI maintains capital requirements
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The additional capital requirements are intended to enhance the resilience of these institutions.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has retained State Bank of India (SBI), HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank in its 2026 list of Domestic Systemically Important Banks (D-SIBs), maintaining their respective positions under the same bucketing structure as in 2025. Under the RBI’s framework, SBI, placed in Bucket 4, will have to maintain an additional Common Equity Tier 1 (CET1) capital requirement of 0.80% of its Risk Weighted Assets (RWAs). HDFC Bank, classified under Bucket 2, will have an additional CET1 requirement of 0.40%, while ICICI Bank, placed in Bucket 1, will have to maintain 0.20%. These additional capital requirements are over and above the Capital Conservation Buffer, strengthening the banks’ ability to absorb financial shocks and contain systemic risks. The latest classification is based on data collected from banks as of March 31, 2026. Under the D-SIB framework, banks are categorised into different buckets according to their Systemic Importance Scores (SISs), with higher scores attracting higher additional capital requirements. The RBI introduced the Framework for Dealing with D-SIBs on July 22, 2014, subsequently updating it on December 28, 2023. The framework requires the central bank to publicly disclose the names of designated D-SIBs annually, beginning in 2015, and assign them to appropriate buckets based on their systemic importance. SBI and ICICI Bank were initially designated as D-SIBs in 2015 and 2016, respectively. HDFC Bank joined the list in 2017, when all three banks were identified as systemically important financial institutions.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: economy (general) / business (general) / banking / Reserve Bank of India / financial and business service
