🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: People’s Democratic Party legislator Muntazir Mehdi termed the Pakistani Minister’s visit to India “a welcome development” and urged the resumption of dialogue between India and Pakistan

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: J&K Deputy Chief Minister Surinder Choudhary on Friday (November 20, 2026) said that the BJP-led government’s move to invite Pakistan’s Minister Musadik Masood Malik to attend the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Civilisation Dialogue Forum “vindicated the stand of National Conference (NC) president Dr. Farooq Abdullah and vice president Omar Abdullah.” Referring to the BJP’s stance after the 2025 Pahalgam attack, Mr. Choudhary said, “The BJP will say it will not talk to Pakistan. And when Dr. Abdullah and Omar Abdullah advocate dialogue, the BJP will call them Pakistani. I want to ask the BJP: hasn’t a Pakistani Minister been invited to India on their invitation?” He said the invitation to the Pakistani Minister proved that “the stance of my leaders was right then and is right now.” “The NC’s stance is the same as the one articulated by former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee, who would say, ‘You can choose your friends, but you cannot choose your neighbours.’ One must always maintain good relations with one’s neighbours,” said Mr. Choudhary. Asking Pakistan to end terrorism, Mr. Choudhary said, “Both Dr. Abdullah and Omar Abdullah have been asking Pakistan to end terrorism and close terror camps if Pakistan wants better relations. We stand behind our leaders.” People’s Democratic Party legislator Muntazir Mehdi termed the Pakistani Minister’s visit to India “a welcome development” and urged the resumption of dialogue between India and Pakistan.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The two countries share a common history and several mutual concerns, including political issues, climate change, and water-related matters, which can only be addressed through engagement and dialogue. Hostility and non-engagement cannot resolve these issues. Both countries should come to the table and resume dialogue for peace and development in the subcontinent,” he said.

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: J&K Deputy Chief Minister Surinder Choudhary on Friday (November 20, 2026) said that the BJP-led government’s move to invite Pakistan’s Minister Musadik Masood Malik to attend the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Civilisation Dialogue Forum “vindicated the stand of National Conference (NC) president Dr. Farooq Abdullah and vice president Omar Abdullah.” Referring to the BJP’s stance after the 2025 Pahalgam attack, Mr. Choudhary said, “The BJP will say it will not talk to Pakistan. Asking Pakistan to end terrorism, Mr. Choudhary said, “Both Dr. Abdullah and Omar Abdullah have been asking Pakistan to end terrorism and close terror camps if Pakistan wants better relations. articles.title: Transgender persons to be roped in for tax collection in West Bengal
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: West Bengal Minister Agnimitra Paul launches a programme to provide dignified, alternative livelihoods to trans persons

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The West Bengal government will engage transgender persons to collect municipal tax and spread traffic awareness. Urban Development and Municipal Affairs Minister Agnimitra Paul said the initiative, called “Brihannala Brigade”, will provide an opportunity for a dignified livelihood for the transpersons. “The CM wishes that they (transgender people no) longer have to resort to begging at traffic signals; instead, we want to offer them an alternative, respectable livelihood. We have decided that those among them who are interested will receive training from the police and be deployed at traffic signals. Their role will be to sensitise the public about traffic rules and safety measures,” Ms. Paul said on Thursday (November 19, 2026). She further added that another group of transgender persons would be trained to collect outstanding taxes, which could help address the staff shortage that leads to delayed collections and large pending amounts. The Minister also added that each of these transgender individuals will be provided with training to engage in this work so that they can conduct better public interaction and do their work seamlessly. They will receive a stipend for the work, Ms. Paul said. The West Bengal government has started an initiative to offer relief in paying outstanding property taxes, including in the actual sums and interest, to encourage defaulters to pay their outstanding balances. According to Kolkata Municipal Corporation estimates, they have around ₹6800 crore outstanding property tax pending, including personal properties, mixed-use properties, and commercial properties.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In 2022, the previous Mamata Banerjee government decided to allow transgender persons to apply for government jobs under the general category to help them have better opportunities in employment. A Transgender Development Board was set up in 2017, but the board could not undertake many activities for the welfare of members of the community. The last census carried out in the state in 2011 put the number of transgender people in the state at 30,349. The actual number of people of the third gender may be higher, several groups working for the community say.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Transgender persons to be roped in for tax collection in West Bengal

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 03:12:49 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: West Bengal Minister Agnimitra Paul launches a programme to provide dignified, alternative livelihoods to trans persons

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The West Bengal government will engage transgender persons to collect municipal tax and spread traffic awareness. Urban Development and Municipal Affairs Minister Agnimitra Paul said the initiative, called “Brihannala Brigade”, will provide an opportunity for a dignified livelihood for the transpersons. “The CM wishes that they (transgender people no) longer have to resort to begging at traffic signals; instead, we want to offer them an alternative, respectable livelihood. We have decided that those among them who are interested will receive training from the police and be deployed at traffic signals. Their role will be to sensitise the public about traffic rules and safety measures,” Ms. Paul said on Thursday (November 19, 2026). She further added that another group of transgender persons would be trained to collect outstanding taxes, which could help address the staff shortage that leads to delayed collections and large pending amounts. The Minister also added that each of these transgender individuals will be provided with training to engage in this work so that they can conduct better public interaction and do their work seamlessly. They will receive a stipend for the work, Ms. Paul said. The West Bengal government has started an initiative to offer relief in paying outstanding property taxes, including in the actual sums and interest, to encourage defaulters to pay their outstanding balances. According to Kolkata Municipal Corporation estimates, they have around ₹6800 crore outstanding property tax pending, including personal properties, mixed-use properties, and commercial properties.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: In 2022, the previous Mamata Banerjee government decided to allow transgender persons to apply for government jobs under the general category to help them have better opportunities in employment. A Transgender Development Board was set up in 2017, but the board could not undertake many activities for the welfare of members of the community. The last census carried out in the state in 2011 put the number of transgender people in the state at 30,349. The actual number of people of the third gender may be higher, several groups working for the community say.

✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile
Opportunity (Noun)
अवसर — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Opportunity' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Interaction (Adjective / Verb)
इंटरैक्शन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Interaction' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Transgender persons to be roped in for tax collection in West Bengal", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. West Bengal Minister Agnimitra Paul launches a programme to provide dignified, alternative livelihoods to trans persons.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Transgender persons to be roped in for tax colle' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Transgender persons to be roped in for tax co' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Transgender persons to be roped in for tax co' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "West Bengal Minister Agnimitra Paul launches a programme to provide dignified, alternative livelihoods to trans persons." A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.

C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "The actual number of people of the third gender may be higher, several groups working for the community say." (Hinglish Arth: समुदाय के लिए काम करने वाले कई समूहों का कहना है कि तीसरे लिंग के लोगों की वास्तविक संख्या अधिक हो सकती है।)

articles.title: Trinamool supporters attacked outside the police station as police questioned Abhishek
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The supporters of Trinamool had gathered outside the police station in support of Abhishek Banerjee

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Supporters of Mamata All India Trinamool Congress (AITC) were allegedly attacked on Friday (November 20, 2026) by supporters of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) outside a police station while party leader Abhishek Banerjee was being questioned by Kolkata Police at the Girish Park police station. Videos of the scuffle and the assault on women supporters of the Trinamool were shared on social media and by the Mamata AITC. In the videos, groups of women alleged to be BJP supporters were seen chasing another group of women. Supporters of the Trinamool had gathered outside the police station in support of Abhishek Banerjee. The BJP leaders denied allegations of the assault but claimed that Trinamool supporters were trying to incite tensions by gathering outside the police station. “@BJP4Bengal workers gathered outside Girish Park Police Station today, seemingly intent on harassing, heckling and assaulting our workers, did not even spare ordinary citizens and parents who had come to pick up their children from school,” the party shared on social media. The Mamata AITC leader raised questions on the role of politics. The police complaint against the Diamond Harbour MP was filed in connection with remarks reportedly made by him on 29 October, in which he criticised sections of the police administration, alleging that officers were acting under political pressure. Mr. Banerjee took to social media to share videos of BJP leaders, including Suvendu Adhikari, alleging threats to the police when they were in the Opposition. After the BJP came to power, several FIRs were registered against Abhishek Banerjee. He has been summoned to appear before the police on numerous occasions. Later in the day, the Trinamool leader filed a Zero FIR at Girish Park Police Station, highlighting how Suvendu Adhikari, Dilip Ghosh, and other BJP leaders threatened the Kolkata Police and the West Bengal Police on multiple occasions.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The expertise and urgency shown by Girish Park PS in connection with Abhishek Banerjee’s matter—we hope the same expertise and urgency will be shown by them in connection with this Zero FIR, and that they will investigate the matter,” Arka Nag, an advocate representing Trinamool Congress leader, said.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Trinamool supporters attacked outside the police station as police questioned Abhishek

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 03:00:12 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The supporters of Trinamool had gathered outside the police station in support of Abhishek Banerjee

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Supporters of Mamata All India Trinamool Congress (AITC) were allegedly attacked on Friday (November 20, 2026) by supporters of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) outside a police station while party leader Abhishek Banerjee was being questioned by Kolkata Police at the Girish Park police station. Videos of the scuffle and the assault on women supporters of the Trinamool were shared on social media and by the Mamata AITC. In the videos, groups of women alleged to be BJP supporters were seen chasing another group of women. Supporters of the Trinamool had gathered outside the police station in support of Abhishek Banerjee. The BJP leaders denied allegations of the assault but claimed that Trinamool supporters were trying to incite tensions by gathering outside the police station. “@BJP4Bengal workers gathered outside Girish Park Police Station today, seemingly intent on harassing, heckling and assaulting our workers, did not even spare ordinary citizens and parents who had come to pick up their children from school,” the party shared on social media. The Mamata AITC leader raised questions on the role of politics. The police complaint against the Diamond Harbour MP was filed in connection with remarks reportedly made by him on 29 October, in which he criticised sections of the police administration, alleging that officers were acting under political pressure. Mr. Banerjee took to social media to share videos of BJP leaders, including Suvendu Adhikari, alleging threats to the police when they were in the Opposition. After the BJP came to power, several FIRs were registered against Abhishek Banerjee. He has been summoned to appear before the police on numerous occasions. Later in the day, the Trinamool leader filed a Zero FIR at Girish Park Police Station, highlighting how Suvendu Adhikari, Dilip Ghosh, and other BJP leaders threatened the Kolkata Police and the West Bengal Police on multiple occasions.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “The expertise and urgency shown by Girish Park PS in connection with Abhishek Banerjee’s matter—we hope the same expertise and urgency will be shown by them in connection with this Zero FIR, and that they will investigate the matter,” Arka Nag, an advocate representing Trinamool Congress leader, said.

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Trinamool supporters attacked outside the police station as police questioned Abhishek", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The supporters of Trinamool had gathered outside the police station in support of Abhishek Banerjee.

C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Trinamool supporters attacked outside the pol' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Trinamool supporters attacked outside the pol' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.

Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Trinamool supporters attacked outside the police station as police questioned Abhishek"?

C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "“The expertise and urgency shown by Girish Park PS in connection with Abhishek Banerjee’s matter—we hope the same expertise and urgency will be shown..." articles.title: Chandel district official issues advisory after spurious liquor kills 11 in Manipur
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: The Chandel district authorities have urged the people to report suspected manufacturing, storage, sale or distribution of adulterated liquor

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Manipur’s Chandel district administration on Friday (November 20, 2026) issued an advisory, urging people to report suspected manufacturing, storage, sale or distribution of adulterated liquor. The public advisory followed the death of 11 people due to consumption of spurious liquor in the district’s Chakpikarong Sub-Division. The deaths have been reported since Tuesday (November 17, 2026). According to a statement from the Chief Minister’s Office, 180 others are undergoing treatment at two private hospitals in Imphal. Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh visited these hospitals on Friday and took stock of the treatment being provided to the patients. Advising the general public to exercise utmost caution, the district administration said the cause of the deaths was yet to be “medically and scientifically established”. It asked people to refrain from consuming locally brewed liquor or alcoholic beverages of doubtful origin, particularly from suspected sources in the affected areas. “Any person experiencing vomiting, abdominal pain, headache, dizziness, blurred vision, breathing difficulty or other unusual symptoms following alcohol consumption should immediately seek medical attention at the nearest facility,” the advisory read. It also advised people who may have consumed liquor from the same suspected source to seek medical evaluation even if they are not experiencing symptoms. “The public is requested to report suspected manufacturing, storage, sale or distribution of adulterated liquor to the nearest police station or the concerned authorities,” the advisory further read, requesting village authorities, civil society organisations, women’s organisations and youth clubs to assist in spreading awareness. The Manipur government partially lifted 30 years of alcohol prohibition in December 2023, although extremist groups in the State continue to target liquor businesses. Years of prohibition led to certain areas turning into local liquor dens, selling alcoholic beverages of suspect quality.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Spurious liquor has claimed lives in other northeastern States where prohibition is enforced. For instance, 23 people were killed in Nagaland’s Mokokchung and Tuensang districts about two months ago.

options: Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
For instance, 23 people were killed in Nagaland’s Mokokchung and Tuensang districts about two months ago.
Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #12 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Chandel district official issues advisory after spurious liquor kills 11 in Manipur

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 02:16:29 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: The Chandel district authorities have urged the people to report suspected manufacturing, storage, sale or distribution of adulterated liquor

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Manipur’s Chandel district administration on Friday (November 20, 2026) issued an advisory, urging people to report suspected manufacturing, storage, sale or distribution of adulterated liquor. The public advisory followed the death of 11 people due to consumption of spurious liquor in the district’s Chakpikarong Sub-Division. The deaths have been reported since Tuesday (November 17, 2026). According to a statement from the Chief Minister’s Office, 180 others are undergoing treatment at two private hospitals in Imphal. Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh visited these hospitals on Friday and took stock of the treatment being provided to the patients. Advising the general public to exercise utmost caution, the district administration said the cause of the deaths was yet to be “medically and scientifically established”. It asked people to refrain from consuming locally brewed liquor or alcoholic beverages of doubtful origin, particularly from suspected sources in the affected areas. “Any person experiencing vomiting, abdominal pain, headache, dizziness, blurred vision, breathing difficulty or other unusual symptoms following alcohol consumption should immediately seek medical attention at the nearest facility,” the advisory read. It also advised people who may have consumed liquor from the same suspected source to seek medical evaluation even if they are not experiencing symptoms. “The public is requested to report suspected manufacturing, storage, sale or distribution of adulterated liquor to the nearest police station or the concerned authorities,” the advisory further read, requesting village authorities, civil society organisations, women’s organisations and youth clubs to assist in spreading awareness. The Manipur government partially lifted 30 years of alcohol prohibition in December 2023, although extremist groups in the State continue to target liquor businesses. Years of prohibition led to certain areas turning into local liquor dens, selling alcoholic beverages of suspect quality.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Spurious liquor has claimed lives in other northeastern States where prohibition is enforced. For instance, 23 people were killed in Nagaland’s Mokokchung and Tuensang districts about two months ago.

Enforcement (Noun)
सख्ती से कानून लागू करना — किसी नियम या आदेश का ज़मीनी स्तर पर पालन करवाना।
✓ Syn: Implementation, Execution, Administration  |  ✖ Ant: Neglect, Abandonment, Waiver
Administration (Noun)
प्रशासन — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Administration' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Distribution (Adjective / Verb)
वितरण — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Distribution' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Consumption (Noun)
उपभोग — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Consumption' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Chandel district official issues advisory after spurious liquor kills 11 in Manipur", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. The Chandel district authorities have urged the people to report suspected manufacturing, storage, sale or distribution of adulterated liquor.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Chandel district official issues advisory after ' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Chandel district official issues advisory aft' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Chandel district official issues advisory aft' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "The Chandel district authorities have urged the people to report suspected manufacturing, storage, sale or distribution of adulterated liquor." (Hinglish Arth: चंदेल जिले के अधिकारियों ने लोगों से मिलावटी शराब के संदिग्ध विनिर्माण, भंडारण, बिक्री या वितरण की रिपोर्ट करने का आग्रह किया है)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Chandel district official issues advisory after spurious liquor kills 11 in Manipur"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. For instance, 23 people were killed in Nagaland’s Mokokchung and Tuensang districts about two months ago.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.

• 1. Core Context & Background: The Chandel district authorities have urged the people to report suspected manufacturing, storage, sale or distribution of adulterated liquor
• 2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Manipur’s Chandel district administration on Friday (November 20, 2026) issued an advisory, urging people to report suspected manufacturing, storage, sale or distribution of adulterated liquor. The public advisory followed the death of 11 people due to consumption of spurious liquor in the district’s Chakpikarong Sub-Division. The deaths have been reported since Tuesday (November 17, 2026). According to a statement from the Chief Minister’s Office, 180 others are undergoing treatment at two private hospitals in Imphal. Chief Minister Yumnam Khemchand Singh visited these hospitals on Friday and took stock of the treatment being provided to the patients. Advising the general public to exercise utmost caution, the district administration said the cause of the deaths was yet to be “medically and scientifically established”. It asked people to refrain from consuming locally brewed liquor or alcoholic beverages of doubtful origin, particularly from suspected sources in the affected areas. “Any person experiencing vomiting, abdominal pain, headache, dizziness, blurred vision, breathing difficulty or other unusual symptoms following alcohol consumption should immediately seek medical attention at the nearest facility,” the advisory read. It also advised people who may have consumed liquor from the same suspected source to seek medical evaluation even if they are not experiencing symptoms. “The public is requested to report suspected manufacturing, storage, sale or distribution of adulterated liquor to the nearest police station or the concerned authorities,” the advisory further read, requesting village authorities, civil society organisations, women’s organisations and youth clubs to assist in spreading awareness. The Manipur government partially lifted 30 years of alcohol prohibition in December 2023, although extremist groups in the State continue to target liquor businesses. Years of prohibition led to certain areas turning into local liquor dens, selling alcoholic beverages of suspect quality.
• 3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Spurious liquor has claimed lives in other northeastern States where prohibition is enforced. For instance, 23 people were killed in Nagaland’s Mokokchung and Tuensang districts about two months ago.

articles.title: Anthropic researcher says Claude solved maths’ greatest riddle
articles.examRelevance: Current Affairs & GS-II: Bilateral Treaties, Global Summits (UN/G20/BRICS/Quad) & Strategic Diplomacy
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: First proposed by German mathematician Bernhard Riemann in 1859, the hypothesis concerns the distribution of prime numbers and is widely regarded as the most important open question in pure mathematics

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A mathematician at AI company Anthropic said Friday (November 20, 2026) that he had used the firm’s Claude chatbot to prove the Riemann Hypothesis, a problem that has eluded mathematicians for more than 160 years. “I believe I have, working with Claude, discovered proof of the Riemann Hypothesis,” Levent Alpoge wrote in a four-page note released Friday (November 20, 2026). The claim has not been independently verified, and the proof has not yet been reviewed by outside experts. First proposed by German mathematician Bernhard Riemann in 1859, the hypothesis concerns the distribution of prime numbers and is widely regarded as the most important open question in pure mathematics. It is one of seven Millennium Prize Problems selected by the Clay Mathematics Institute in 2000, which offers $1 million for a solution to each. Under the institute’s rules, a solution must be published in a peer-reviewed journal and withstand two years of scrutiny. Mr. Alpoge said the method also resolves a broader version of the problem known as the Generalised Riemann Hypothesis. He said he and Claude had produced a version of the proof in Lean, a programming language that allows mathematical arguments to be checked by a computer, and that he was releasing only that version for now. A full written argument would be extremely long, he said, adding that he had not yet mastered all of the mathematics involved and planned to write it up properly.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Alpoge said he had consulted Anthropic chief executive Dario Amodei before announcing the result and acknowledged that its timing could be viewed cynically, without elaborating, though he was probably referring to this week’s record IPO.

🌐 International & Geopolitics Paragraph #19 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Anthropic researcher says Claude solved maths’ greatest riddle

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 12:05:22 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: First proposed by German mathematician Bernhard Riemann in 1859, the hypothesis concerns the distribution of prime numbers and is widely regarded as the most important open question in pure mathematics

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: A mathematician at AI company Anthropic said Friday (November 20, 2026) that he had used the firm’s Claude chatbot to prove the Riemann Hypothesis, a problem that has eluded mathematicians for more than 160 years. “I believe I have, working with Claude, discovered proof of the Riemann Hypothesis,” Levent Alpoge wrote in a four-page note released Friday (November 20, 2026). The claim has not been independently verified, and the proof has not yet been reviewed by outside experts. First proposed by German mathematician Bernhard Riemann in 1859, the hypothesis concerns the distribution of prime numbers and is widely regarded as the most important open question in pure mathematics. It is one of seven Millennium Prize Problems selected by the Clay Mathematics Institute in 2000, which offers $1 million for a solution to each. Under the institute’s rules, a solution must be published in a peer-reviewed journal and withstand two years of scrutiny. Mr. Alpoge said the method also resolves a broader version of the problem known as the Generalised Riemann Hypothesis. He said he and Claude had produced a version of the proof in Lean, a programming language that allows mathematical arguments to be checked by a computer, and that he was releasing only that version for now. A full written argument would be extremely long, he said, adding that he had not yet mastered all of the mathematics involved and planned to write it up properly.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Alpoge said he had consulted Anthropic chief executive Dario Amodei before announcing the result and acknowledged that its timing could be viewed cynically, without elaborating, though he was probably referring to this week’s record IPO.

Mathematical (Adjective)
गणितीय — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Mathematical' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।

Anthropic (Adjective)
महत्वपूर्ण विश्लेषणात्मक शब्द — इस लेख में 'Anthropic' मुख्य प्रभाव और नीतिगत स्थिति को स्पष्ट करता है।

fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: U.S., China, Russia must draw up a roadmap for talks on nuclear weapons

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The first trilateral summit between the Presidents of China, the U.S. and Russia , held in Shenzhen on November 19, reflected both the changing global order and the leaders’ shared desire to remain engaged with one another in an increasingly unpredictable world. For U.S. President Donald Trump, the summit was a platform where he could push for joint talks between the world’s three largest nuclear powers on reducing nuclear warheads. After the New START treaty between the U.S. and Russia expired in February 2026, Moscow had signalled that it was ready for talks, but Mr. Trump wanted to involve China as well. For President Xi Jinping, the summit reinforced China’s position as a peer competitor to the U.S. While Russia seeks to deepen partnership with China, the U.S. is looking to build strategic stability. And for Russian President Vladimir Putin, whom the West sought to isolate after he launched the invasion of Ukraine, the summit offered a seat at the high table. The decision to start trilateral talks on nuclear arms and the joint declaration, which stated that ‘a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought’, are steps in the right direction. But much will depend on what follows.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Many had compared the meet to the 1945 Yalta Conference, when Russian leader Joseph Stalin, U.S. President Franklin D. Roosevelt and British Prime Minister Winston Churchill met to discuss the future of post-War Europe. But Shenzhen was not a summit of the victors of a major war. This was more about three great powers setting terms of engagement in a changing world. The summit failed to achieve any breakthrough on any of the issues on the agenda — nuclear arms reduction, non-proliferation or the Ukraine war — or even offer a road map for the future. Moreover, it is not clear if the Shenzhen spirit could be sustained in the medium to long-term as another President in the U.S. could take a very different approach towards Russia and China. The three leaders have called for reform of the UN. While it is a welcome move, any attempt to reform the international system and institutions must also involve other powers, particularly rising middle powers such as India, South Africa and Brazil. But the Shenzhen framework could bring greater stability and predictability to great-power relations. This is important given that two of the Big Three are currently waging two separate wars. The leaders should draw up a clear road map for nuclear talks and other key issues outlined in the Shenzhen declaration, with realistic and achievable objectives. Otherwise, the summit would amount to little more than another diplomatic photo-op.

✍️ Editorial & Opinion Paragraph #4 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Three to tango: On Trump, Xi, Putin trilateral summit

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 08:17:55 AM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: U.S., China, Russia must draw up a roadmap for talks on nuclear weapons

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The first trilateral summit between the Presidents of China, the U.S. and Russia , held in Shenzhen on November 19, reflected both the changing global order and the leaders’ shared desire to remain engaged with one another in an increasingly unpredictable world. For U.S. President Donald Trump, the summit was a platform where he could push for joint talks between the world’s three largest nuclear powers on reducing nuclear warheads. After the New START treaty between the U.S. and Russia expired in February 2026, Moscow had signalled that it was ready for talks, but Mr. Trump wanted to involve China as well. For President Xi Jinping, the summit reinforced China’s position as a peer competitor to the U.S. While Russia seeks to deepen partnership with China, the U.S. is looking to build strategic stability. And for Russian President Vladimir Putin, whom the West sought to isolate after he launched the invasion of Ukraine, the summit offered a seat at the high table. The decision to start trilateral talks on nuclear arms and the joint declaration, which stated that ‘a nuclear war cannot be won and must never be fought’, are steps in the right direction. But much will depend on what follows.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Many had compared the meet to the 1945 Yalta Conference, when Russian leader Joseph Stalin, U.S. President Franklin D. Roosevelt and British Prime Minister Winston Churchill met to discuss the future of post-War Europe. But Shenzhen was not a summit of the victors of a major war. This was more about three great powers setting terms of engagement in a changing world. The summit failed to achieve any breakthrough on any of the issues on the agenda — nuclear arms reduction, non-proliferation or the Ukraine war — or even offer a road map for the future. Moreover, it is not clear if the Shenzhen spirit could be sustained in the medium to long-term as another President in the U.S. could take a very different approach towards Russia and China. The three leaders have called for reform of the UN. While it is a welcome move, any attempt to reform the international system and institutions must also involve other powers, particularly rising middle powers such as India, South Africa and Brazil. But the Shenzhen framework could bring greater stability and predictability to great-power relations. This is important given that two of the Big Three are currently waging two separate wars. The leaders should draw up a clear road map for nuclear talks and other key issues outlined in the Shenzhen declaration, with realistic and achievable objectives. Otherwise, the summit would amount to little more than another diplomatic photo-op.

📚 TOP 4 HARD VOCABULARY WORDS EXTRACTED FROM THIS PARAGRAPH (TAP CARD FOR PICTURE & SYNONYMS):
Predictably (Adverb)
जैसा पहले से अनुमान था — बिना किसी आश्चर्य के बिल्कुल पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक होना।
✓ Syn: Foreseeably, Expectedly, Inevitably  |  ✖ Ant: Unexpectedly, Surprisingly, Abruptly
Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।
✓ Syn: Systemic, Organizational, Constitutional  |  ✖ Ant: Individual, Informal, Unorganized
Sustainability (Noun)
सतत विकास — पर्यावरण और भविष्य की पीढ़ियों को नुकसान पहुँचाए बिना लंबे समय तक चलने वाला विकास।
✓ Syn: Viability, Eco-balance, Durability  |  ✖ Ant: Depletion, Unsustainability, Destruction
Proliferation (Noun)
प्रसार — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Proliferation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above ✍️ Editorial & Opinion passage on "Three to tango: On Trump, Xi, Putin trilateral summit", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. U.S., China, Russia must draw up a roadmap for talks on nuclear weapons.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Three to tango: On Trump, Xi, Putin trilateral s' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Three to tango: On Trump, Xi, Putin trilatera' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Three to tango: On Trump, Xi, Putin trilatera' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "U.S., China, Russia must draw up a roadmap for talks on nuclear weapons." (Hinglish Arth: अमेरिका, चीन, रूस को परमाणु हथियारों पर बातचीत के लिए एक रोडमैप तैयार करना चाहिए)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Three to tango: On Trump, Xi, Putin trilateral summit"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. Otherwise, the summit would amount to little more than another diplomatic photo-op.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "Otherwise, the summit would amount to little more than another diplomatic photo-op." (Hinglish Arth: अन्यथा, शिखर सम्मेलन एक और राजनयिक फोटो-ऑप से थोड़ा अधिक होगा।)

articles.title: 14 flights cancelled at Ranchi airport amid Cyclone 'Akvan' | LIVE
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Odisha Chief Minister said heavy rainfall was expected in Mayurbhanj and Balasore over the next 24 hours, with its impact likely to extend to neighbouring Jajpur, Bhadrak, Kendrapara and Jagatsinghpur districts

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: As many as 14 flights were cancelled at the Birsa Munda Airport in Ranchi on Saturday (November 21) due to inclement weather triggered by cyclone ‘Akvan’, an official said. Cyclone Akvan causes 14 Ranchi airport flight cancellations due to poor visibility and bad weather. Relief operations are underway on a war footing in Odisha’s Ganjam district after Cyclone Akvan. An ODRAF team carried out a tree-cutting operation under the Jarau Nal bridge in Chhandikendu village to clear the affected area. Normalcy has been restored at Puri beach after Cyclone Akvan. Beach activities have resumed, bringing the shoreline back to life after the disruption caused by the cyclone. Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu sought central assistance of nearly ₹100 crore for the restoration of horticultural crops damaged by cyclones Arnab and Murasu. “Naidu has written a letter to Union Minister for Agriculture and Farmers Welfare Shivraj Singh Chouhan, seeking additional financial assistance for the restoration of horticulture crops damaged by two consecutive cyclones,” a press release said. The cyclones damaged crops across 29,960 hectares in 18 districts, affecting 71,576 farmers and causing losses estimated at ₹1,092 crore, he said. The cyclone had considerably lost its intensity when it made landfall near Gopalpur in Odisha. “The cyclonic storm Akvan crossed the south coastal Odisha and north Andhra Pradesh close to Gopalpur with a wind speed of 70-80 kmph, gusting to 90 kmph during 7.30 a.m. to 8.30 a.m.,” said the India Meteorological Department (IMD). Landfall of Cyclone Akvan nears Odisha and Andhra Pradesh coasts as land interaction begins, with heavy rainfall and prolonged impact anticipated.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The depression is likely to move nearly northwards over Odisha and weaken further into a low-pressure area during next 6 hours, said IMD

3. articles.title: Break free of limiting beliefs to achieve new heights: PM Modi at IIT Kharagpur
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Narendra Modi joins Platinum Jubilee celebrations of the first IIT of the country and says the institute has and will continue to play a major role in nation building

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Saturday (November 21, 2026) said that if people go ahead with the “nation first” mindset, then new opportunities will come their way. He asked students to break free of limiting beliefs to achieve new heights, at the Platinum jubilee celebrations of the Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur. “This place has always come forward in building the nation at every stage of the country since its independence,” Mr. Modi said while addressing the students at the 75th anniversary celebrations at IIT Kharagpur, which is also the first IIT of independent India. He also hoped that the institute will continue to make similar contributions in building the future of the nation. “We have limiting beliefs; we limit our thoughts, our dreams, our aspirations, our talent, and give up. But we only reach our full potential if we break free of the limits to unlock new possibilities,” Mr. Modi said. He added that people put limit to their own thoughts, restricting the opportunities in their lives and of the nation. Mr Modi said that during his tenure as the PM, he has broken the limits and achieved many such goals which people believed to be “impossible”. “ Poverty in India was known to be a permanent problem. But there was no real change made through policy; they only made files. People took the situation for granted. But when we came to power, we changed this mentality and empowered the poor and started schemes to get them out of poverty,” Mr. Modi said. He added that according to a World Bank report, in the last 12-13 years at least 50 crore people in India have been taken out of poverty. Mr. Modi added that in the coming days, when India is going forward towards a “Viksit Bharat”, IIT Kharagpur is sure to play a major role in building that dream. The PM further said that he hopes the 100 years of IIT Kharagpur will be celebrated in the Vikshit Bharat in the coming years. VIDEO | Kharagpur, West Bengal: At the Platinum Jubilee celebrations of IIT Kharagpur, Prime Minister Narendra Modi says, "Break the limit, unlock the possibilities. Let me share a few examples with you today. Just think, until 20 years ago, poverty was considered a permanent problem in our country. Five decades ago, slogans were raised from the Red Fort about eradicating poverty. However, whenever it came to taking action at the policy level, the entire system would simply prepare files and sit idle." (Source: Narendra Modi YT) (Full video available on PTI Videos - https://t.co/bIyFWTfmBd) West Bengal Governor R.N. Ravi , Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari and Higher Education Minister Jagannath Chattopadhyay were among the others present at the 75-year program.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Meanwhile, the director of the institute took the stage and said that under the PM’s leadership, they are now remaining true to the mission of IIT Kharagpur. “From grassroots to skyrockets, that is the new IIT Kharagpur,” Professor Suman Chakraborty said. He also added that IIT Kharagpur alumni and Google CEO Sundar Pichai have offered a 5 million dollar support for applied Artificial Intelligence research.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #10 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Break free of limiting beliefs to achieve new heights: PM Modi at IIT Kharagpur

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 02:11:34 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Narendra Modi joins Platinum Jubilee celebrations of the first IIT of the country and says the institute has and will continue to play a major role in nation building

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Saturday (November 21, 2026) said that if people go ahead with the “nation first” mindset, then new opportunities will come their way. He asked students to break free of limiting beliefs to achieve new heights, at the Platinum jubilee celebrations of the Indian Institute of Technology, Kharagpur. “This place has always come forward in building the nation at every stage of the country since its independence,” Mr. Modi said while addressing the students at the 75th anniversary celebrations at IIT Kharagpur, which is also the first IIT of independent India. He also hoped that the institute will continue to make similar contributions in building the future of the nation. “We have limiting beliefs; we limit our thoughts, our dreams, our aspirations, our talent, and give up. But we only reach our full potential if we break free of the limits to unlock new possibilities,” Mr. Modi said. He added that people put limit to their own thoughts, restricting the opportunities in their lives and of the nation. Mr Modi said that during his tenure as the PM, he has broken the limits and achieved many such goals which people believed to be “impossible”. “ Poverty in India was known to be a permanent problem. But there was no real change made through policy; they only made files. People took the situation for granted. But when we came to power, we changed this mentality and empowered the poor and started schemes to get them out of poverty,” Mr. Modi said. He added that according to a World Bank report, in the last 12-13 years at least 50 crore people in India have been taken out of poverty. Mr. Modi added that in the coming days, when India is going forward towards a “Viksit Bharat”, IIT Kharagpur is sure to play a major role in building that dream. The PM further said that he hopes the 100 years of IIT Kharagpur will be celebrated in the Vikshit Bharat in the coming years. VIDEO | Kharagpur, West Bengal: At the Platinum Jubilee celebrations of IIT Kharagpur, Prime Minister Narendra Modi says, "Break the limit, unlock the possibilities. Let me share a few examples with you today. Just think, until 20 years ago, poverty was considered a permanent problem in our country. Five decades ago, slogans were raised from the Red Fort about eradicating poverty. However, whenever it came to taking action at the policy level, the entire system would simply prepare files and sit idle." (Source: Narendra Modi YT) (Full video available on PTI Videos - https://t.co/bIyFWTfmBd) West Bengal Governor R.N. Ravi , Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari and Higher Education Minister Jagannath Chattopadhyay were among the others present at the 75-year program.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Meanwhile, the director of the institute took the stage and said that under the PM’s leadership, they are now remaining true to the mission of IIT Kharagpur. “From grassroots to skyrockets, that is the new IIT Kharagpur,” Professor Suman Chakraborty said. He also added that IIT Kharagpur alumni and Google CEO Sundar Pichai have offered a 5 million dollar support for applied Artificial Intelligence research.

Institutional (Adjective)
संस्थागत — देश की संवैधानिक या सरकारी संस्थाओं के नियमों और ढांचे से जुड़ा हुआ।

स्वतंत्रता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Independence' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Intelligence (Adjective / Verb)
बुद्धिमत्ता — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Intelligence' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Restrictive, Counteractive, Adverse  |  ✖ Ant: Constructive, Supportive, Favorable
Artificial (Adjective)
कृत्रिम — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Artificial' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Comprehensive, Influential, Decisive  |  ✖ Ant: Superficial, Ineffective, Fragile

Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Break free of limiting beliefs to achieve new heights: PM Modi at IIT Kharagpur", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Narendra Modi joins Platinum Jubilee celebrations of the first IIT of the country and says the institute has and will continue to play a major role...

C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Break free of limiting beliefs to achieve new' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Break free of limiting beliefs to achieve new' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. He also added that IIT Kharagpur alumni and Google CEO Sundar Pichai have offered a 5 million dollar support for applied Artificial Intelligence...
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "He also added that IIT Kharagpur alumni and Google CEO Sundar Pichai have offered a 5 million dollar support for applied Artificial Intelligence..." articles.title: Kannada writer Ravi Hanj arrested at Kochi airport amid Basava Mantapa book controversy
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Ravi Hanj was detained during security checks while attempting to travel abroad, say Kerala Police sources. He will be handed over to Karnataka Police

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Kannada writer Ravi Hanj, who is at the centre of a major controversy over alleged derogatory remarks against 12th-century social reformer Basavanna in his book Basava Mantapa and in interviews around the book , has been detained by Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) personnel at Cochin International Airport in Keralam. Mr. Hanj was detained during security checks on Saturday (November 21, 2026) while attempting to travel abroad, State police sources said. He was being taken for medical examinations, the sources said. The CISF took Mr. Hanj into custody acting on a lookout notice issued against him by the Belagavi police. He will be handed over to the Karnataka Police, sources added. Mr. Hanj was recently booked by the police in Bengaluru, Belagavi, Bagewadi and Vijayapura following complaints alleged derogatory remarks against Basavanna and the Lingayat community. The Karnataka Cabinet on Thursday decided to confiscate his book following complaints by Veerashiva-Lingayat groups. The book’s publisher, Vishweshwar Bhat, has also been named in the Bengaluru and Vijayapura FIRs. The book is a compilation of columns published in the Viswavani newspaper under the same title Basava Mantapa . It was released as a book in Bengaluru on November 15. The government decided to confiscate the book following representations from Basava Samiti that alleged that the writer made the derogatory remarks in the book and in an interview published on Viswavani’s social media channels on November 13. The complaints have sought legal action against the writer, editor and others allegedly involved, and requested authorities to prevent further circulation of the book and content that could hurt religious sentiments. The BJP also demanded action against the writer.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Karnataka Deputy Chief Minister G. Parameshwara, briefing the media after Thursday’s Cabinet meeting, had said they were not banning the book but “forfeiting all copies”, and there was a provision for the same under the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023. However, there had been no notification from the government till November 21 afternoon to empower the police to forfeit the books.

🏛️ Political, National & Polity Paragraph #11 of 30 (21 NOV)

📰 Kannada writer Ravi Hanj arrested at Kochi airport amid Basava Mantapa book controversy

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 02:07:16 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Ravi Hanj was detained during security checks while attempting to travel abroad, say Kerala Police sources. He will be handed over to Karnataka Police

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Kannada writer Ravi Hanj, who is at the centre of a major controversy over alleged derogatory remarks against 12th-century social reformer Basavanna in his book Basava Mantapa and in interviews around the book , has been detained by Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) personnel at Cochin International Airport in Keralam. Mr. Hanj was detained during security checks on Saturday (November 21, 2026) while attempting to travel abroad, State police sources said. He was being taken for medical examinations, the sources said. The CISF took Mr. Hanj into custody acting on a lookout notice issued against him by the Belagavi police. He will be handed over to the Karnataka Police, sources added. Mr. Hanj was recently booked by the police in Bengaluru, Belagavi, Bagewadi and Vijayapura following complaints alleged derogatory remarks against Basavanna and the Lingayat community. The Karnataka Cabinet on Thursday decided to confiscate his book following complaints by Veerashiva-Lingayat groups. The book’s publisher, Vishweshwar Bhat, has also been named in the Bengaluru and Vijayapura FIRs. The book is a compilation of columns published in the Viswavani newspaper under the same title Basava Mantapa . It was released as a book in Bengaluru on November 15. The government decided to confiscate the book following representations from Basava Samiti that alleged that the writer made the derogatory remarks in the book and in an interview published on Viswavani’s social media channels on November 13. The complaints have sought legal action against the writer, editor and others allegedly involved, and requested authorities to prevent further circulation of the book and content that could hurt religious sentiments. The BJP also demanded action against the writer.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Karnataka Deputy Chief Minister G. Parameshwara, briefing the media after Thursday’s Cabinet meeting, had said they were not banning the book but “forfeiting all copies”, and there was a provision for the same under the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023. However, there had been no notification from the government till November 21 afternoon to empower the police to forfeit the books.

✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
Circulation (Noun)
प्रसार — इस अनुच्छेद में 'Circulation' का प्रयोग एक महत्वपूर्ण प्रशासनिक और विश्लेषणात्मक अर्थ में किया गया है।
✓ Syn: Significant, Substantial, Strategic  |  ✖ Ant: Insignificant, Negligible, Trivial
🧠 2 ANALYTICAL EXAM QUESTIONS BASED ON THIS EDITORIAL:
Q1. Based on a critical reading of the above 🏛️ Political, National & Polity passage on "Kannada writer Ravi Hanj arrested at Kochi airport amid Basava Mantapa book controversy", which of the following statements accurately reflects the central analytical observation of the text?
A. Ravi Hanj was detained during security checks while attempting to travel abroad, say Kerala Police sources.
B. Contrary to the passage, the issue of 'Kannada writer Ravi Hanj arrested at Kochi airpo' requires zero institutional or regulatory intervention at any level.
C. The passage argues that all empirical data and statutory mechanisms related to 'Kannada writer Ravi Hanj arrested at Kochi ai' should be permanently discontinued.
D. The author contends that 'Kannada writer Ravi Hanj arrested at Kochi ai' has no bearing on public governance, economy, or citizen welfare.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (A) — Sahi Jawab Option (A) hai. Is passage ki mukhya line saaf batati hai: "Ravi Hanj was detained during security checks while attempting to travel abroad, say Kerala Police sources." (Hinglish Arth: केरल पुलिस के सूत्रों का कहना है कि रवि हंज को विदेश यात्रा की कोशिश के दौरान सुरक्षा जांच के दौरान हिरासत में लिया गया था।)
Q2. Which of the following key analytical points or conclusions is explicitly highlighted by the author in the passage regarding "Kannada writer Ravi Hanj arrested at Kochi airport amid Basava Mantapa book controversy"?
A. Advocating complete policy paralysis and ignoring ground-level implementation challenges.
B. However, there had been no notification from the government till November 21 afternoon to empower the police to forfeit the books.
C. Dismissing constitutional accountability and relying solely on unverified short-term measures.
D. Recommending the immediate suspension of all regulatory and scientific assessments mentioned in the text.
✅ Correct Answer: Option (B) — Sahi Jawab Option (B) hai. Lekhak ne passage ke vishleshan mein is baat par zor diya hai: "However, there had been no notification from the government till November 21 afternoon to empower the police to forfeit the books." (Hinglish Arth: हालाँकि, पुलिस को किताबें जब्त करने का अधिकार देने के लिए 21 नवंबर की दोपहर तक सरकार की ओर से कोई अधिसूचना नहीं आई थी।)

articles.title: People will never forget BRS corruption: Telangana Congress president Mahesh Kumar Goud
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-II & Polity: Constitutional Amendments, Supreme Court Judgements, Parliamentary Bills & Governance Schemes
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: Telangana Pradesh Congress Committee (TPCC) president and MLC Mahesh Kumar Goud claimed that people would never forget the alleged misappropriation of public money by the previous Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) government and resources given the large-scale corruption during its decade-long rule.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Speaking to the media in Nizamabad, he said several instances of corruption during the previous regime had come to light with evidence, and those responsible could not escape accountability. His response comes in the wake of BRS party’s relentless criticism of corruption charges against the Congress government. He alleged that former Chief Minister K. Chandrashekhar Rao and former Minister T. Harish Rao were responsible for the alleged exploitation of Telangana’s water resources during the BRS regime. The Kaleshwaram project, conceived as a major irrigation initiative, had resulted in the wastage of public money worth several lakh crore rupees, he charged. The BRS regime had also witnessed large-scale irregularities in land transactions and land-related matters, he alleged, adding that the list of alleged corruption cases under the previous government was extensive. To a question, Mr. Goud described Congress leader Rahul Gandhi as a leader committed to serving the country, and that national service and public welfare remained his priorities. On inter-State water disputes, he asserted that Telangana would not surrender even a single drop of its legitimate share of water. The Congress government was committed to protecting the State’s interests and ensuring that its rightful water allocations were secured, he said.
3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy was governing with determination, keeping development as the government’s principal objective, the TPCC president said.

📌 Published: 21 Nov 2026, 02:06:10 PM
🎙️ Desi Hinglish Voice Educator • 🚂 Live Train Line Highlight & Screen Lock

1. Core Context & Background: Telangana Pradesh Congress Committee (TPCC) president and MLC Mahesh Kumar Goud claimed that people would never forget the alleged misappropriation of public money by the previous Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) government and resources given the large-scale corruption during its decade-long rule.

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Speaking to the media in Nizamabad, he said several instances of corruption during the previous regime had come to light with evidence, and those responsible could not escape accountability. His response comes in the wake of BRS party’s relentless criticism of corruption charges against the Congress government. He alleged that former Chief Minister K. Chandrashekhar Rao and former Minister T. Harish Rao were responsible for the alleged exploitation of Telangana’s water resources during the BRS regime. To a question, Mr. Goud described Congress leader Rahul Gandhi as a leader committed to serving the country, and that national service and public welfare remained his priorities. On inter-State water disputes, he asserted that Telangana would not surrender even a single drop of its legitimate share of water. The Congress government was committed to protecting the State’s interests and ensuring that its rightful water allocations were secured, he said.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy was governing with determination, keeping development as the government’s principal objective, the TPCC president said.

articles.title: Infra push and low base effect pushes core sector growth to series-high of 10.9% in October 2026
articles.examRelevance: GS Paper-III & IBPS/SBI/RBI/SSC: RBI Monetary Policy, GDP Growth, Inflation, Fiscal Deficit & Trade Balance
fullParagraphs: 1. Core Context & Background: While the coal and electricity sectors saw growth shoot up, a large part of this was due to a statistical effect rather than growth in actual output. On the other hand, fuel-related sectors contracted again

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: Growth in the core industrial sectors of the economy climbed to a series-high of 10.9% in October 2026, driven by a surge in electricity generation, and coal, cement, and iron ore production, and a low base effect, official data released on Friday (November 20, 2026) showed. Data released by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry on the Index of Core Industries shows that growth in October surpassed the 8.2% in September, the previous series high. The new index, released this year with a base year of 2022-23, has data that goes back only up to April 2024. However, the data also shows that the strong growth figure in October was also likely aided by the fact that the index grew a relatively poor 0.8% in October last year. “While core output surged by 10.9% in October 2026, the fastest pace in the new series, this was supported by a low base related to the shift in the festive calendar, with output having expanded by a marginal 0.8% in the year ago month,” Aditi Nayar, chief economist at ICRA said. “While the growth print for October 2026 signals a strong start for the third quarter of FY2027, this is largely optical,” Ms. Nayar added. “The average performance for October-November 2026 would provide a better assessment, as this would adjust for festive base effects.” Within the index, the coal sector saw growth accelerating to 23.05% in October 2026, far faster than the 10.7% registered in September. October’s performance, however, is likely also due to low base effect, since the sector contracted 8.4% in October last year. The growth in the index, however, is in line with what the industry itself has reported. Coal India, the country’s largest coal company, reported that production increased about 19% to 67.2 million tonnes (MT) in October. A major reason for the growth in coal production was likely demand from the power sector, which saw electricity generation jump by 21.6% in October 2026, up from 12.6% in the previous month. However, this sector too could have benefited from a low base effect, since it contracted nearly 7% in October 2025. Within the index, the infrastructure-related sectors were the only ones that grew strongly without the aid of a statistical low base effect.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: The iron ore sector, for example, grew at a three-month high of 23.4% in October 2026, compared to 18.4% in September and 8.7% in October last year. One of the factors driving this strong growth was that steel production grew at 7.3% in October, the fastest rate in seven months.
