1. Core Context & Background: Europe must be part of any settlement on the Ukraine war

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The trilateral negotiations in Abu Dhabi between Russia, Ukraine and the U.S. earlier this month failed to produce a major breakthrough or bridge the wide gap between Kyiv and Moscow. Yet, they were a good beginning towards finding a political settlement to Europe’s longest war since the Second World War . In the two-day talks, hosted by the U.S., the warring sides agreed on some humanitarian measures, including prisoner exchange. U.S. representatives Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff met Russian President Vladimir Putin in Moscow after the talks to discuss the proposal. In the next stage, U.S., Ukrainian and European officials will meet in Berlin to discuss a coordinated European and Ukrainian position towards the peace process. As of now, Russian and Ukrainian positions remain far apart. Russia demands Ukraine withdraw from the territories of Donbas it still controls to stop attacks. Russia also wants to introduce limits to Ukrainian military capabilities and Kyiv to declare neutrality (give up its NATO ambitions). Ukraine, on the other hand, has rejected making any territorial concessions for a settlement and asked for security guarantees from the West so that Russia would not attack the country again. That Ukraine survived Russia’s invasion and continued to resist Russian forces for almost five years is no small feat. But it has also paid a huge price for its resistance. The country has lost more than 20% of its territory. Millions have fled, while men of fighting age are being drafted into the military . Ukraine’s economy is kept afloat by European support, while its military continues to rely on NATO for weapons and other supplies. Until recently, the West stood united in its support for Ukraine against Russia, but that unity has since begun to fray. U.S. President Donald Trump, who has lifted sanctions on Russian diesel, is seeking to reset Washington’s ties with Moscow . European leaders, who initially sought to isolate Russia, have also started reestablishing contacts with the Kremlin. In October, Finnish and Norwegian leaders held direct talks with Mr. Putin. To be sure, Ukraine’s long-range strikes can hurt Russia, as the recent attack on the Kerch Bridge demonstrated. But such strikes are unlikely to change the Kremlin’s thinking about the war. As the conflict drags on, Ukraine’s position is weakening, and its allies are growing increasingly divided. After almost five years, Russia has failed to take a decisive victory. Ukraine does not have a credible path towards victory either. A diplomatic settlement, therefore, is the only way forward. The Abu Dhabi talks recognised this reality. But for the process to be meaningful, Europe must also be brought to the negotiating table.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: World / Ukraine / USA / Russia-Ukraine Crisis / war / war

The Minister sought precise details on where such incidents were occurring, promising strict action.

Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: For at least three years, the personal data that voters submitted to the Election Commission of India through Form 6, the application for registration as an elector, was exposed on its Citizen Service Portal (https://voters.eci.gov.in/ ) to anyone with a login, claims a report by ‘Charchagram’, a civic-tech initiative for building tools for enhancing transparency and accountability in public systems of India. According to the report, using ECI published data, it estimates that at least seven crore Form 6 enrolments took place in this period. Each Form 6 application holds a citizen’s name, their relative’s name, gender, phone number, email, home address, photograph, Aadhaar details, age-proof documents, and address-proof documents, among other details. “We audited the front-end code available in public. And while auditing, [we] found that there is URL through which anyone can access Form 6 data of other voters,” said Saurav Rajput, a data scientist at Charchagram. Opening “voters.eci.gov.in/form6?refId= ” returned a web-page showing all the applicants’ details to any logged-in user, regardless of who the applicant was. “The reference IDs follow a predictable state, constituency, type and date/sequence pattern. The server did not check that the application belonged to the person asking. The predictability of the reference ID amplifies this security issue, since any user can scrape the data one by one in large volumes,” according to the report. Following the revelation, Charchagram says it reported the matter privately to the ECI and to CERT-In. CERT-In is the national nodal agency for responding to computer security incidents as and when they occur.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: “We asked for a fix within seven days and for written acknowledgement and confirmation when it was done,” Mr. Rajput said.

Reviewing the functioning of the Real Time Governance Society (RTGS) with senior officials of various departments on Sunday, Mr. Naidu stressed the need to leverage modern technology and the AI stack to simplify government services and improve the performance of departments. He directed officials to take measures to ensure that public services were delivered more efficiently and promptly. He also called for capacity-building programmes to enhance the technological capabilities and professional skills of government employees. Stressing that delays in addressing public grievances should be avoided, the Chief Minister has directed officials to expedite the resolution of complaints received through the Public Grievance Redressal System. A positive public perception of government services was essential for improving governance and called upon departments to regularly review their performance and address shortcomings in monitoring mechanisms, he said. Mr. Naidu said the government was using Revenue and Legal AI stacks to analyse various issues and identify ways to improve departmental performance. Data-driven decision-making would become increasingly important in governance in the coming years, he observed. Referring to the recent local body elections, he said the results could serve as one of the indicators of the government’s performance. He asked senior departmental officials to strengthen monitoring mechanisms and ensure better delivery of services to the public.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Senior officials from the Social Welfare, BC Welfare, Minority Welfare, Finance, Municipal Administration and Energy departments, besides RTGS officials, participated in the review meeting.

dailyQuiz10.explanation:
1. Core Context & Background: Sunny Joseph announces that the Idukki and Cheruthoni dams will be opened to tourists starting December 1

2. Constitutional / Economic / Policy Analysis: The government will explore all possible ways to avoid power restrictions in the State, Electricity Minister Sunny Joseph has said. Addressing a Kerala State Electricity Board (KSEB) review meeting at Thodupuzha in Idukki on Monday, Joseph said that due to the El Niño effect, rainfall has been largely reduced in the State, affecting the storage levels of hydroelectric dams. “Compared to the previous year, the water level in Idukki, including major hydel dams, is more than 20% below storage this year. Presently, there is only 60% storage in the hydel dams in the State,” the Minister said. Mr. Joseph further noted that the government will t launch initiatives to arrange power from other sources. According to KSEB data, the water level in the Idukki dam on Monday was 2,368.9 feet (63%), compared with 2,384.98 feet (79%) on the same day last year. During the meeting, the Minister announced that the Idukki and Cheruthoni dams will be opened to tourists starting December 1. He said the decision was taken based on repeated demands from various quarters. The Minister also directed officials to take steps to resume the boating facility at the Anayirankal dam reservoir. Based on the recommendation of a panel appointed by the High Court to address human-animal conflicts in Chinnakkanal, the boating facility in Anayirankal was suspended following the court’s direction on July 14, 2023. The panel had argued that stopping the boating facility in Anayirankal would help prevent human-elephant conflicts in the Anayirankal and Chinnakkanal regions.

3. Way Forward & Exam Conclusion: Mr. Joseph further noted that to tap the tourism potential in Idukki, the KSEB and the Tourism department will jointly implement projects in the district. He also said the Electricity department will seek permission from the forest department to set up an overhead power line to Edamalakkudy, the State’s first tribal panchayat, to provide electricity to the tribal community.
